RaceName: Sky Bet Lowther Stakes (Group 2) (Fillies) (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 240,000gns breeze-up buy who won easily on debut at Lingfield (5f, good to firm) and kept on well for sixth of 27 in a hot renewal of the Group 2 Queen Mary at Royal Ascot (5f, good to firm); disappointing in the Group 3 Princess Margaret at Ascot (6f, good to firm) last month but she started awkwardly and is better than that; retains potential at 6f; could bounce back.

RaceName: Sky Bet Lowther Stakes (Group 2) (Fillies) (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Thrown in at the deep end on debut in the Listed Marygate here (5f, good) in May and did very well to finish fourth; easily made all at 11-10 in three-runner maiden at Hamilton (6f, good) in June; off since and up in grade today but it remains to be seen where the ceiling of her ability lies.

RaceName: Sky Bet Lowther Stakes (Group 2) (Fillies) (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Her six starts have yielded two wins, in a 5f novice here (good) in June and a 5f Listed race at Naas (good) four weeks ago when showing improved form in a first-time visor (retained) to make virtually all from Shimmering Sun; ran well over 6.2f in May; this Irish challenger could be a factor.

RaceName: Sky Bet Lowther Stakes (Group 2) (Fillies) (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: All five starts at 5f; won at Ascot (good) on second outing and bounced back from heavy Royal Ascot defeat with Listed win at Sandown (good) under Ryan Moore, who is back on board today; didn't run up to her best in the Super Sprint at Newbury and now tackles 6f; others appeal more.

RaceName: Sky Bet Lowther Stakes (Group 2) (Fillies) (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Kept on well for fifth in a strong running of the Queen Mary at Royal Ascot (5f, good to firm) and got off the mark at the fourth attempt in Listed race at Deauville (5f, good to soft) last month, with a next-time-out Listed winner in second; a line can be put through her run in the Molecomb at Goodwood as she stumbled; looks a good prospect for 6f and is one to consider.

RaceName: Sky Bet Lowther Stakes (Group 2) (Fillies) (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: All three runs at 5f on good to firm; won the Hilary Needler at Beverley in May on her second start then mid-division in the Queen Mary at Royal Ascot behind a few of these; the step up to 6f could suit but lots of improvement is needed.

RaceName: Sky Bet Lowther Stakes (Group 2) (Fillies) (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Has shown ability but she's 0-4 and yet to pose a serious threat, including when 250-1 at Royal Ascot; she would be a shock winner today.

RaceName: Sky Bet Lowther Stakes (Group 2) (Fillies) (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 320,000gns yearling who has an attractive pedigree and is a close relation to 6f Group 2 winner El Caballo; weak in the betting but won four-runner maiden at 13-2 on debut at Carlisle (5f, good to firm) in June; wind op since; takes on a vastly better calibre of opponent this afternoon but she's very unexposed and could be an exciting prospect; no surprise to see a big run.

RaceName: Sky Bet Lowther Stakes (Group 2) (Fillies) (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Won debut at Newmarket (6f, good) in May and respectable runs in Group races since, finishing ninth in the Albany at Royal Ascot (6f, good to firm) then fifth in the Duchess Of Cambridge at Newmarket (6f, good to firm), both times behind Libertango; improvement possible but she has to settle better.

RaceName: Sky Bet Lowther Stakes (Group 2) (Fillies) (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 400,000gns breeze-up buy who made it 2-2 when coming from a tough position to win the Group 3 Albany at Royal Ascot (6f, good to firm); close second in the Group 2 Duchess Of Cambridge at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) since and the third was a convincing Listed winner next time; leading claims.

RaceName: Sky Bet Lowther Stakes (Group 2) (Fillies) (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Made it 2-2 when leading in the final strides in the Listed Marygate Stakes here (5f, good) in May; hasn't kicked on since, however, finishing down the field at Royal Ascot (5f, good to firm) and merely fourth on recent nursery debut at Newmarket (6f, good to firm); others are preferred.

RaceName: Sky Bet Lowther Stakes (Group 2) (Fillies) (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Impressive on debut at Chepstow (6f, good to soft) in June and not beaten far when fifth to Moonrise in the Group 3 Princess Margaret at Ascot (6f, good to firm); improvement is needed but she didn't look the finished article last time, having failed to settle and flashed her tail; not ruled out.

RaceName: Sky Bet Lowther Stakes (Group 2) (Fillies) (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Her dam is from a classy family and this filly posted a cosy win on debut at Carlisle (6f, good to firm) in June; beaten about 2l by runner-up Libertango when fourth in Group 2 Duchess Of Cambridge Stakes at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) last month but that was a very creditable performance on just her second start and her powerful finish hinted that a stronger early gallop would have been favourable; not discounted.

RaceName: Sky Bet Lowther Stakes (Group 2) (Fillies) (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Won Newmarket novice (6f, good to firm) last month on third start and midfield in Listed race at Newbury (5f, good to firm) last Friday; the return to 6f can help but it seems likely her limitations will again be exposed.

RaceName: Sky Bet Lowther Stakes (Group 2) (Fillies) (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Won on debut at Salisbury (5f, good) in May and kept on well for seventh in the Group 2 Queen Mary at Royal Ascot (5f, good to firm), a race that has worked out extremely well; again finished strongly when Listed runner-up to Big Negotiator at Naas (5f, good) four weeks ago and this first crack at 6f could be right up her street; firmly in calculations.

RaceName: Sky Bet Lowther Stakes (Group 2) (Fillies) (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Inexperience evident when runner-up to Livenka on last month's debut at Fairyhouse (6f, good) and showed the benefit of that experience when easily justifying 1-3 odds in Leopardstown maiden (6.5f, good) eight days later; it's possible she didn't beat much last time but she was certainly impressive, and has been supplemented for this race at a cost of £20,000; dam was a 2yo Group 3 winner; she's one to be interested in.

RaceName: Sky Bet Lowther Stakes (Group 2) (Fillies) (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: All three starts over 5f; won by 10l on debut at Carlisle in May (good, good to soft in places) and, although she was a touch underwhelming in the Queen Mary at Royal Ascot (good to firm), she won a quality conditions race at Glorious Goodwood (good to firm) three weeks ago; having drawn clear close home last time there is every chance that 6f will suit; contender.

RaceName: EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 95,000gns yearling; eye-catching third on Wolverhampton debut (5f, AW) last month and she didn't get much luck when fourth at Sandown (5f, good to firm) 18 days later; that form puts her firmly in the picture and she's open to more progress on this step up in trip; interesting contender.

RaceName: EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: £140,000 breeze-up 2yo; showed clear promise on Bath debut in May and she built on that when going close over this trip at York (good to firm) two weeks ago; just about sets the standard on that clear third and she should continue to improve with experience; key player.

RaceName: EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 35,000gns yearling, 55,000gns breeze-up 2yo; fourth foal; sister to 1m-1m2f winner Phone Tag (including 2yo; RPR 79); dam 1m 2yo winner (75), half-sister to 7.6f/1m winner Drymee, out of French 1m 2yo winning half-sister to useful 1m1f-1m4f winner Demolition; yard 0-6 with 2yos this season and she could be a longer-term prospect.

RaceName: EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 70,000gns yearling; third foal; dam 5f 2yo winner (RPR 92), half-sister to winners Heartache (5f 2yo Group 2), Unbreak My Heart (Group-placed 5f 2yo) and Heartwarming (Listed-placed 5f 2yo), out of 5f Listed winner; tongue-tie is applied on debut and market should guide.

RaceName: EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Looked inexperienced but she shaped with promise when a 20-1 second on her debut over C&D (good to firm) two weeks ago; that form is not strong but she should know more this time and is open to progress on her second start.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: Showed some ability when fourth of seven on her Redcar debut (5f, good to firm) in May before running poorly over 6f one month later; plenty of encouragement to be gleaned from her AW debut, however, when runner-up over C&D nine days ago; player.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: 30,000euros yearling; 50-1 for her debut in the Lily Agnes at Chester (5f, good) in May when she missed the break and couldn't get out of last place; absent since but this is much easier and maybe a new hood will help; market should be a good guide.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: 8,000gns yearling by Harry Angel; first foal; dam runner-up 5f (RPR 57), closely related to 6f winner Sushi, half-sister to Listed-placed winners Queen Of Time (7f-1m2f) and Bounce (6f 2yo), out of 6f 2yo winner; yard is 1-26 with its juveniles at the start of play yesterday.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: By Twilight Son; fourth foal; half-sister to 5f winner Glamorous Joy (RPR 61); dam 5f winner (including AW; 85), closely related to multiple 5f winner Glamorous Force, out of 5f Group 3 winning half-sister to 5f Group 3 winner Just Glamorous; yard is 0-5 with 2yos this term but that's a speedy pedigree.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: Promising fifth on debut in May was built on when second at Catterick (good to firm) last month; similar form when fairly close third back at Thirsk (again 5f, good) a fortnight ago; has been racing freely so the new hood looks a good move for her AW debut; considered.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: 38,000gns yearling; second foal; Mehmas half-sister to 1m winner Harlequin Breeze (RPR 89); dam Listed-placed 1m 2yo winner (95), half-sister to winners Tigerwolf (6f-1m) and Know No Limits (6f/7f 2yo), out of half-sister to Hollywood Derby runner-up Fast And Furious; stable not noted for winning 2yo newcomers but she'll require a market check.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: By Land Force; fifth foal; half-sister to 5f-7f winner Hannah's Return (including AW; RPR 63); dam 5f/6f winner (mainly AW; 93), half-sister to 5f/6f winner Lordsbridge Boy, out of German 6f 2yo winning sister to German 6.5f 2yo Listed winner Gooseley Lane; widest stall unhelpful but stable was recently off the mark with this year's juveniles, from just a handful of runners.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: Best effort when third of ten in a slowly run fillies' maiden over 6f on AW here in June; hasn't matched that on turf subsequently and, while the return here is a positive, she's starting to look exposed; drops back to 5f with cheekpieces discarded after one use.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: 250-1 before finishing last in both outings; one for handicaps.

RaceName: Harry's Half Million By Goffs (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Improving gelding who won his second Group race when taking three-runner Group 2 Prix Robert Papin at Chantilly (6f, good) one month ago; shoulders a 7lb penalty but he may be capable of better again and rates a leading contender.

RaceName: Harry's Half Million By Goffs (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Experienced juvenile who has won two of his ten starts, including a Class 2 seller at Musselburgh (5f, good) in June which leaves him with a 5lb penalty; passed over.

RaceName: Harry's Half Million By Goffs (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Built on his debut to take a Class 2 novice narrowly at Hamilton (6f, good) in May; 5lb penalty for that win makes life even harder and he was down the field in a tongue-tie at Newcastle four weeks ago.

RaceName: Harry's Half Million By Goffs (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Carries a 3lb penalty for winning Class 3 Haydock novice (good to soft) in May; solid effort when third in Glorious Goodwood nursery (again 7f, good to firm) last time but that still leaves him a little short of the required standard on this drop back to 6f.

RaceName: Harry's Half Million By Goffs (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Only just denied on debut and impressed with 5l win on second start; well backed when a close second in the Albany at Royal Ascot and was then a snug odds-on winner of Curragh Group 2 eight days later; took it up another notch with convincing win in Group 1 Phoenix Stakes at the Curragh (6f, good to firm) 11 days ago; 7lb penalty and she's out fairly quickly again but she sets a high bar.

RaceName: Harry's Half Million By Goffs (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Off the mark at the third attempt when he came nicely clear close home over 5f at Thirsk (good) 19 days ago; step back up to 6f should be no problem but that bare form needs a big chunk of improvement.

RaceName: Harry's Half Million By Goffs (GBB Race)
OwnerName: The Good Racing Co Ltd & Partners
Spotlight: First two starts at 6f and he looked to appreciate the drop to 5f when tenth of 21 in Royal Ascot's Norfolk (good to firm) two months ago; has since been gelded and undergone wind surgery.

RaceName: Harry's Half Million By Goffs (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Tongue tied all starts; won her first two, including when she shared a Newmarket Listed event (6f, good to firm) in June; not so good last time and she has a 5lb penalty.

RaceName: Harry's Half Million By Goffs (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Improver; picked up a 5f Pontefract maiden (good) in April and had no problem with 6f when taking a Nottingham nursery in July; missed the break but still went on to run well when third of 18 in Glorious Goodwood nursery (again 6f, good to firm) four weeks later; holds Group entries and he's likely better than his current mark; not ruled out.

RaceName: Harry's Half Million By Goffs (GBB Race)
Spotlight: All starts at 5f; appeared to run quite well when sixth in Sandown Listed event (good) last month and he didn't need to better that effort when opening his account at Lingfield (good to firm) three weeks later; this is a very different test.

RaceName: Harry's Half Million By Goffs (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Runner-up on debut in May to a subsequent Listed winner and made no mistake in big-field Redcar maiden (6f, good) a fortnight later; belied an awkward head carriage to battle back and score under a penalty at Thirsk last time; has work to do on the figures but might surprise a few.

RaceName: Harry's Half Million By Goffs (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Big step up from his debut when he scampered clear to win four-runner Salisbury novice (6f, good to firm) four weeks ago; needs to improve again but it's highly unlikely we've seen the best of him and he's respected as one of three for a yard that's on a four-timer in this race.

RaceName: Harry's Half Million By Goffs (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Mrs Anne Atkinson And H D Atkinson
Spotlight: Unbeaten colt who was 28-1 when winning on his debut at Redcar in June and showed a good attitude when defying a penalty at Ripon (again 5f, good) one month later; this step up to 6f could unlock more and he might go well for a long way.

RaceName: Harry's Half Million By Goffs (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Middleham Park Racing Xvii & M Parker
Spotlight: Made all in 12-runner Windsor maiden on his introduction in May and followed up under a penalty at Newbury (again 6f, good to firm) last month; jockey bookings suggest he's the pick of a three-pronged attack from a yard that's won this race for the last three years; respected.

RaceName: Harry's Half Million By Goffs (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Stepped forward from his debut to be third of 12 at Windsor (6f, good to firm) last month; plenty to do on that bare form but his yard's record in this race ensures he's not instantly dismissed and Dylan Browne McMonagle is an eye-catching jockey booking.

RaceName: Harry's Half Million By Goffs (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Well-held third behind Where Love Lives on debut at Thirsk (5f, good) in April; different story over 6f on soft ground when drawing away late to bag Ayr maiden two months ago; has some punchy future entries and, while he might already be looking for further, he's not one to rule out at likely rewarding odds.

RaceName: Harry's Half Million By Goffs (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Did just enough to score at Newmarket (good to firm; solid form) on his second start and it wasn't a bad effort when fourth in valuable Naas event (also 6f, good) 17 days ago; needs more, though.

RaceName: Harry's Half Million By Goffs (GBB Race)
Spotlight: All starts at 5f; she made the perfect start at Thirsk (good) in April but it's been downhill in better events subsequently; steps up to 6f with blinkers added.

RaceName: Harry's Half Million By Goffs (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Yard is no stranger to success in this sort of event and she looked on the up when bounding clear in 6f Goodwood maiden (soft) in June; only sixth of nine in a Newmarket nursery 19 days ago, however.

RaceName: Harry's Half Million By Goffs (GBB Race)
Spotlight: All starts at 6f on good to firm and she's displayed similar ability across the three of them, latterly off the mark by a head at Yarmouth a fortnight ago; requires a step up.

RaceName: Harry's Half Million By Goffs (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Redcar novice winner on her debut in April who was less than 2l behind Tokaido in Chantilly Listed event (good) the following month; big run when second in another French Listed race (again 5f) 12 days ago; should stay 6f on pedigree and has solid each-way claims on that latter form.

RaceName: Van Buck 50th Anniversary Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 95,000gns yearling but re-sold for £20,000 at a breeze-up; half-sister to two useful winners including Zihba (7f/1m including Group 3; RPR 104); 11-2 on Catterick debut (7f, good to firm) last month and she found plenty before staying on strongly to beat nine rivals; this is tougher under a penalty but that was a bright start and she's open to progress upped in trip.

RaceName: Van Buck 50th Anniversary Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Half-sister to six winners but she was 50-1 at Goodwood (7f, good to firm) three weeks ago and beat only one rival in that 13-runner maiden; can only be watched after that low-key start.

RaceName: Van Buck 50th Anniversary Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 75,000euros Irish breeze-up 2yo; weak 20-1 shot on recent Nottingham debut (6f, good to firm; 20-1) and she finished a well-held fourth of seven; this trip should be a better fit on pedigree but she needs a major step forward on her second start.

RaceName: Van Buck 50th Anniversary Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Both runs have been at big prices over 7f (good to firm) on this course; rallied well when third in a novice (third of seven) last month and she wasn't disgraced in the Group 3 Sweet Solera last time; has leading claims now back in much calmer waters and she's out of a 1m winner.

RaceName: Van Buck 50th Anniversary Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Ninth foal; half-sister to winners King Zain (7f including 2yo; RPR 106), Porters Place (7f 2yo; 90), Duvessa (10.6f AW; 87), Kamili (1m; 83), Shringara (1m3f; 79) and Dark Side (US 1m/8.5f); dam 1m-9.4f winner (including Group 3; 108); well-bred newcomer and she needs watching in market.

RaceName: Van Buck 50th Anniversary Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
OwnerName: M L W Bell Racing Ltd
Spotlight: 15,000gns breeze-up 2yo; half-sister to winners Theotherside (6f including 2yo; RPR 92), Starboy (6f/7f including 2yo; 91), Fat Gladiator (7f AW; 72), Chevillon (1m AW 2yo; 71) and Dandy Fitz (5f; 66); dam 1m winner (including 2yo; 93); has fair target to aim at on debut and market should guide.

RaceName: Free Tips On attheraces.com EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
OwnerName: Berkshire Parts & Panels Ltd No1 Fanclub
Spotlight: 35,000euros foal; 90,000gns yearling; fifth foal; Calyx half-brother to French winners Illois (9.5f/1m2f AW) and Imbleville (10.5f AW); dam 9.5f-10.7f winner (including AW); likely type; market can guide.

RaceName: Free Tips On attheraces.com EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Second foal; by Blue Point out of 1m 2yo/1m6f winner (RPR 98) who also acted well on Polytrack, half-sister to multiple winner Dubday (including 1m4f Group 3) and Dannyday (useful at 1m5f-2m on AW); yard hasn't had many 2yos run on the AW this year (1-7) but the betting should be helpful.

RaceName: Free Tips On attheraces.com EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 3,000gns yearling; second foal; by Cracksman out of unraced half-sister to winners including Shalaa (6f 2yo Group 1); likely best watched as yard doesn't target 2yo races.

RaceName: Free Tips On attheraces.com EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 50,000euros yearling; third foal; Minzaal half-brother to 1m2f winner Heiselectric (RPR 89); dam unraced half-sister to winners Zoffman (1m2f/1m4f Flat and 2m hurdle) and Sheishybrid (12.6f/2m2f Flat and 2m1f/2m2f hurdle); leading trainer is 8-64 with 2yos here in the last five years.

RaceName: Free Tips On attheraces.com EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Promising start over 6f but best form when a one-paced third in 1m Listed race in July; perhaps found yielding ground against him in an easier grade at Galway (7f) next time, finding zero, but he may do better on sand with cheekpieces fitted; leading Irish yard 0-5 with juveniles on AW in Britain.

RaceName: Free Tips On attheraces.com EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Third foal; by Zarak; closely related to 1m2f winner Blessed Honour (RPR 86); dam unraced half-sister to Listed winners Doom (7f/1m) and Lilt (1m), out of US 9.5f/1m2f Grade 1 winner; top trainer's juveniles have a cracking strike-rate on sand, 34% in the last five years.

RaceName: Free Tips On attheraces.com EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 67,000gns yearling; fifth foal; by Space Blues; closely related to Qatari 9.5f winner Sydney Mews; dam 1m/8.4f winner (RPR 93), half-sister to 2m2f Group 2 and smart 2m-2m5f hurdle winner Thomas Hobson; trainer has done well with 2yos on turf this year but less so on AW; likely other days.

RaceName: Free Tips On attheraces.com EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Ninth foal; Golden Horn half-sister to six winners including Cabaletta (1m-1m4f including 2yo/Listed);  Pivotal Trigger (7f 2yo/1m2f; 101) and Baihas (1m6f; 90); dam 1m4f-2m winner (including French St Leger; 115); interesting newcomer but no surprise if this is needed.

RaceName: Sir Kevin Sinfield 7 In 7 Grand Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Made it four wins from his last ten starts when scoring at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) recently; on a lofty mark under a 6lb penalty and it remains to be seen if he's just as good over 1m, but there can be optimism in that regard and he's clearly progressive; has run well on soft/good to soft.

RaceName: Sir Kevin Sinfield 7 In 7 Grand Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Uncharacteristically below par at Ascot recently but was under a new rider in the Shergar Cup; he's run really well in defeat under Danny Tudhope in some hot handicaps this year and was second in this last season (good to firm); versatile ground-wise; could bounce back with a big performance.

RaceName: Sir Kevin Sinfield 7 In 7 Grand Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Looked very promising in 2024 on first two starts (7f/1m, good/heavy) and returned from long absence to win a Southwell novice (1m, AW) at 6-4 two months ago; in a hot race on a lofty mark for his handicap debut but very unexposed and could well be up to the task for his top yard.

RaceName: Sir Kevin Sinfield 7 In 7 Grand Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Added to his two AW wins early this year when scoring over C&D (good to firm) last month; 6lb higher in hotter race today but this lightly raced 4yo is progressive; unraced on slow turf but dam's family excelled on it.

RaceName: Sir Kevin Sinfield 7 In 7 Grand Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Failed to kick on after winning this last year (good to firm) but he returned to form in first-time cheekpieces (retained today) when runner-up at Ascot (1m, good to firm) recently; won on soft ground early in career; firmly in the mix if backing up that latest performance.

RaceName: Sir Kevin Sinfield 7 In 7 Grand Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: 7yo who is winless since November 2023 but has dropped down the weights and was 4l third of 13 to The Lost King over C&D (good to firm) last month; each-way claims if acting on the ground; his last win came on heavy going but subsequent slow-ground form has been mixed.

RaceName: Sir Kevin Sinfield 7 In 7 Grand Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Returned from a year off with fine fourth in the Buckingham Palace at Royal Ascot (7f, good to firm); not quite at the same level in the Golden Mile at Glorious Goodwood (good to firm) since and could do with settling better, but he was effective over 1m in France (including on testing ground) and is capable of playing a leading role if at the top of his game.

RaceName: Sir Kevin Sinfield 7 In 7 Grand Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Looked very much one to follow after winning his final three runs last term (1m, good to firm/good to soft); that hasn't been the case but he was beaten just a nose at Hamilton (1m, good) two starts ago and perhaps the first-time blinkers will prompt a bigger performance; unproven on soft/heavy.

RaceName: Sir Kevin Sinfield 7 In 7 Grand Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who reappeared with a win in the Spring Mile at Newbury (1m, good to soft; unraced on softer) and won the Buckingham Palace at Royal Ascot (7f, good to firm) in June; below best in the International at Ascot (7f, good to firm) since but still of interest judged on previous exploits.

RaceName: Sir Kevin Sinfield 7 In 7 Grand Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Two quick runs at Glorious Goodwood three weeks ago, beaten only 2l when fifth of 20 on the Wednesday (7f, good to firm) then seventh of 18 in the Golden Mile on the Friday (good to firm) when he would have been closer with a clear run; it's possible he'll be involved; unproven on slow ground.

RaceName: Sir Kevin Sinfield 7 In 7 Grand Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Two wins last year (1m, good to firm/good to soft; he's possibly okay on soft) and added another off this mark at Thirsk (1m, good to firm) in May; however, he's finished no better than seventh across his five runs since.

RaceName: Sir Kevin Sinfield 7 In 7 Grand Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: His three French wins came on slow ground; unplaced this year on his three British starts but best effort came on good to soft when 4l seventh of 18 at Epsom in June when squeezed for room more than once; edging down the weights and slow ground would be a major boost to his claims.

RaceName: Sir Kevin Sinfield 7 In 7 Grand Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Returned to form when going very close at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) last month and again ran well when third of 13 at Haydock (1m, good) 12 days ago; it's possible he's better over 7f but he might not be far away; has won on good to soft, unraced on softer.

RaceName: Sir Kevin Sinfield 7 In 7 Grand Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: His best form has come over 7f on Newmarket's July course (won the Bunbury Cup over that C&D two starts back) but he kept on well when third of 16 in the International at Ascot (7f, good to firm) last time and is worth another crack at 1m; has shown the odd hint of promise at York (including on good to soft ground; unproven on softer); not ruled out.

RaceName: Sir Kevin Sinfield 7 In 7 Grand Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Close third at Newmarket (good) in June when upped to 1m on his second start for this yard, and he made good headway before his run petered out in the John Smith's Cup here (10.2f, good to firm) last month; denied a clear run when mid-division at Glorious Goodwood (1m1f, good to firm) last time; the return to 1m could be ideal; ran well on soft early in career; chance.

RaceName: Sir Kevin Sinfield 7 In 7 Grand Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Two wins in France last year over 7f on very soft/good to soft; mixed form for new yard this year but has twice run well at Chester, most recently second there 18 days ago (7f, good); 1m might be within range and he has possibilities if backing up that latest performance.

RaceName: Come Racing Handicap
Spotlight: Inconsistent seven-race maiden but he's on a reduced mark and made some good late headway when fourth of 11 in a Haydock handicap (7f, good) 13 days ago; this step up in trip should suit on pedigree and he's in the mix with Jamie Spencer booked.

RaceName: Come Racing Handicap
Spotlight: Overall record of 1-22 but he came from rear to finish third behind a major improver over C&D (good to firm) last week; 2lb lower here and has possibilities if he can find some extra spark.

RaceName: Come Racing Handicap
Spotlight: All starts at 7f; showed clear promise in novice/maiden events for Andrew Balding in the spring but he's struggled at big prices in two handicaps for current yard; still unexposed but he needs a transformation at this new trip.

RaceName: Come Racing Handicap
Spotlight: Made it second-time lucky in handicaps when trouncing his rivals at Windsor and he followed up with a 5l success at Carlisle (1m, good) last month; shot up the weights after those wins but he ran another good race when a close fourth over C&D last month; needs to kick on again to defy this mark but he's still lightly raced and is bred to be useful.

RaceName: Come Racing Handicap
OwnerName: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum
Spotlight: Unexposed gelding who was a fair fourth in a Brighton handicap (1m, good to firm) two weeks ago but he hasn't really progressed so far and needs to find more to make a big impact.

RaceName: Come Racing Handicap
Spotlight: Gelded after three ordinary efforts in maidens in the spring; raised his game on handicap debut when a close second at Southwell (1m; tongue-tie added) last month and he built on that when landing the odds in good style at Nottingham (8.3f, good to firm); up 7lb but he still looks feasibly treated on that latest form and is open to more progress; major player.

RaceName: Come Racing Handicap
Spotlight: Won back-to-back handicaps at Windsor (1m, good to firm) in May before a good second in his hat-trick bid at Nottingham; only 1lb higher here but his progress came to a halt at Salisbury (last of six) in June and he has a bit to prove after that.

RaceName: Come Racing Handicap
Spotlight: Eight-race maiden who has finished third in Yarmouth handicaps (1m/1m2f, good to firm) in his last two runs but those were five-runner events and he was beaten 5l last time; others preferred.

RaceName: Air Cool Engineering Handicap
Spotlight: Disappointed on his reappearance in June but he's been running well in three starts since the visor was applied, most recently finishing third of 11 in a 0-75 at Haydock (7f, good) 13 days ago; drops in grade with good claims.

RaceName: Air Cool Engineering Handicap
Spotlight: All five wins have been at this track, with one coming over C&D, the most recent coming off 1lb higher in February; can miss the break, just as she she did when keeping on into third here over 7f last time, but drops in grade and makes the shortlist.

RaceName: Air Cool Engineering Handicap
Spotlight: Both wins have been here over 1m2f, the most recent coming in February off 3lb higher; below his best over 1m3f at Kempton (refused ro settle) in March when last seen and will need them to go a good gallop now that he's dropping back to 1m.

RaceName: Air Cool Engineering Handicap
Spotlight: Two wins from 23 starts include one here over 7f at April; left the impression he's still in form after missing the break here over 7f last week but he's been well beaten in two previous tries over 1m; stamina to prove.

RaceName: Air Cool Engineering Handicap
OwnerName: Dr M Voikhansky & Mrs S Voikhanskaya
Spotlight: 22-race maiden but he has finished in the first three on seven occasions; however, he was down the field at Wolverhampton on his yard debut three weeks ago and needs to bounce back in first-time cheekpieces.

RaceName: Air Cool Engineering Handicap
Spotlight: Caught late after hanging left in a C&D classified event two starts ago before gaining his fifth AW success at Wolverhampton (7f, AW; first-time cheekpieces) three weeks ago; a 4lb rise still leaves him fairly treated on old form and he has to be respected.

RaceName: Air Cool Engineering Handicap
Spotlight: Five-race maiden who has finished third in both starts since switching to handicap company, most recently at Wolverhampton over 7f last month; didn't look to be crying out for this step up to 1m but has each-way claims if seeing it out.

RaceName: Air Cool Engineering Handicap
Spotlight: 16-race maiden but he was runner-up in a 0-80 at York (1m, good to firm) last summer; however, he's struggled in two starts since joining this stable and others look to have stronger claims.

RaceName: Air Cool Engineering Handicap
Spotlight: Caught the attention of the stewards here on turf over 7f two starts ago and looked unfortunate not to finish closer when sixth of eight here on turf over 6f two months ago; looks a potential improver now stepping up in trip on his handicap debut and market support would look significant.

RaceName: Air Cool Engineering Handicap
Spotlight: Five wins include two here over 6f; runner-up here over 7f in January but he hasn't matched that level in three starts since and failed to beat a rival home on his only previous try over 1m; returns from three months off.

RaceName: Air Cool Engineering Handicap
Spotlight: Third of nine over this C&D last October when trained by Michael Keady but he beat only one rival home here over 1m2f on his stable debut nine days ago and his record now reads 0-18; drops back in trip with a visor added.

RaceName: Legends Global Yorkshire Oaks (Group 1) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Poetry in motion up the straight at Ascot where's she registered all three of her Group 1 wins, on a range of ground, crowned by the King George (1m4f, good to firm) last month; unraced here but also shone at Newbury on 2026 reappearance; as today's chief rival on ratings is Minnie Hauk, who finished well adrift of her in the King George, this mare is the one to beat.

RaceName: Legends Global Yorkshire Oaks (Group 1) (Fillies & Mares)
OwnerName: Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor
Spotlight: 1m4f Group 1 wins last summer in the Oaks, Irish Oaks and Yorkshire Oaks before she was beaten a head in the Arc de Triomphe at Longchamp; creditable runner-up to top-class Ombudsman at Royal Ascot this June but disappointing either side of that and well adrift of Kalpana in the King George at Ascot last time; can go head to head with Kalpana if back to her best.

RaceName: Legends Global Yorkshire Oaks (Group 1) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Progressive 3yo on varied ground last season who won a Listed race at Goodwood (1m4f, good) in May on her 2026 reappearance; it was a revelation, though, when she responded so well to sustained pressure to assert by four and a half lengths in the Group 2 Lancashire Oaks at Newmarket (1m4f, good to firm) early last month; problem today is that the Group 1 Yorkshire version includes much more daunting opposition.

RaceName: Legends Global Yorkshire Oaks (Group 1) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Second on soft ground in her only 2yo race; vastly better form on good/good to firm this season, most notably when catching Johanna Walsh on the line in Group 2 Ribblesdale at Royal Ascot; the placings were reversed big time in the Irish Oaks (again 1m4f on good to firm) one month later, which wasn't her true running but she now needs to resume progress and in a major way.

RaceName: Legends Global Yorkshire Oaks (Group 1) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Ran well on soft as 2yo, confined to good or good to firm this season; beat Earth Shot by a head in Listed race at Goodwood in May, which preceded fine Group 1 placed efforts in the 10.4f Prix de Diane at Chantilly and 1m4f Irish Oaks at the Curragh; saw out the 1m4f well but Johanna Walsh was 4l ahead.

RaceName: Legends Global Yorkshire Oaks (Group 1) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Third in a soft-ground maiden on reappearance; huge advances in her three starts since, notably when pipped by Earth Shot at Royal Ascot and 4l winner of Irish Oaks at the Curragh (both 1m4f on good to firm); the latter was in smooth style, as she skipped clear over 1f out before Inis Mor ran on into second, while Earth Shot disappointed in sixth; any further improvement would make her a serious rival for the older stars in this race.

RaceName: Legends Global Yorkshire Oaks (Group 1) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Won the Group 3 Musidora here (10.2f, good) in May and a clear second in the Oaks at Epsom (1m4f, good to soft) in June, albeit no match for the winning stablemate of Johanna Walsh; favourite for the Ribblesdale at Royal Ascot (good to firm) but already no answers when hampered over 1f out; she'd be far from the first to find that race coming too soon after the Oaks and could bounce back, but today's task requires a huge career best.

RaceName: Legends Global Yorkshire Oaks (Group 1) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Unraced on worse than good to yielding; won first three races, notably a 1m4f Group 3 at Cork in June; had to be switched 2f out in Irish Oaks at the Curragh (1m4f, good to firm) next time, keeping fairly close tabs on Inis Mor thereafter as both came from well off the pace to be placed, but Johanna Walsh had gone well beyond recall; while that might have promised better still, she needs to leave this month's flop at Leopardstown way behind her.

RaceName: Legends Global Yorkshire Oaks (Group 1) (Fillies & Mares)
OwnerName: Westerberg & Mrs Magnier & M Tabor & D Smith
Spotlight: 2yo Group 3 winner on heavy who was 6l behind Legacy Link when third in the Oaks at Epsom (1m4f, good to soft) this June; tailed off when 20-1 in Irish Oaks (made most) last time, which was her first run both on good to firm and in cheekpieces; likely to have neither of those today but she is comfortably bottom of this pack on ratings; could have front-running duties.

RaceName: National Stud Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Has been smart in his time and is now 10lb lower than when winning the 2023 Cambridgeshire; returned after a long absence in May, but he's been working his way back to form and was only beaten around 2l when fifth at Southwell (1m3f, AW) last time; looks worth another try at this trip and he's in the mix back on turf.

RaceName: National Stud Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Made a winning debut at Southwell (1m3f, Tapeta) last autumn; flopped at Ascot next time but he bounced back with a close call on handicap debut at Chelmsford (1m2f, AW; 11-4 favourite) in November; 2lb higher on his return but he has plenty of stamina in his pedigree and is open to more progress on this step up to 1m4f; interesting contender.

RaceName: National Stud Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Easy winner of a Ffos Las maiden (1m2f, good) in June and he made it 2-3 when following up with a front-running win in a Doncaster novice (1m2f, good to firm) last month; now steps up in trip but he pulled 11l clear with the runner-up last time and he's strongly respected off what looks a fair opening mark; tongue-tie added.

RaceName: National Stud Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Has form figures of 3112 and that latest second was a close call in a Redcar handicap (1m2f, good to firm) last month; now goes up in trip and grade and but he's only 1lb higher than last time and he should have more to offer; dangerous.

RaceName: National Stud Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: C&D winner last July and he's finished close up back at this track (1m4f, good to firm) in his last two starts; didn't get much luck when fourth in a Class 3 event last time and he's a player off unchanged mark.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On X Handicap
Spotlight: Winner here but that was in 2023 and there's been no win anywhere since July 2024; not far away this summer and he continues down the weights but latest performance (C&D) won't cut the mustard; first-time tongue-tie joins the recent cheekpieces.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On X Handicap
Spotlight: Eight AW wins and latest was over C&D (April); backward steps in his two starts since, finishing last of seven on latest (C&D; 33-1) after two months off but he now drops back in class.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On X Handicap
Spotlight: C&D scorer in 2023 who also won at Epsom (made all; 3lb higher today) last August; 2026 performances don't look good enough, third of five on last two outings.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On X Handicap
Spotlight: Sole dirt run was on debut; 7yo who often ran well on turf in the USA, albeit winning just once (6.5f, firm) back in 2023; showed some ability on both runs last month but others bring more solid claims; usually blinkered in USA and now tries cheekpieces.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On X Handicap
Spotlight: Turned things around with a win at Southwell (7f, Tapeta) last month but he was only seventh of ten in his follow-up bid at Wolverhampton (favourite); used to act on Polytrack; in-form yard also runs Split Elevens; inconsistent.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On X Handicap
OwnerName: The Likely Lads & S & A Mares
Spotlight: 1-18 on other AW tracks (unraced here) but there's plenty on turf and AW to suggest that he has each-way claims.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On X Handicap
Spotlight: Front-runner whose most recent win was at Kempton (1m, AW) last October off 1lb lower; not so good in his only four races since; absent 187 days before his last of 12 at Sandown four weeks ago, so he's a touch speculative this time.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On X Handicap
Spotlight: No significant impact in his three runs for this yard, although he wasn't beaten far on second occasion; attractively weighted on lots of Irish AW form, so needs a close look; market reference recommended.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On X Handicap
Spotlight: Placed on four occasions prior to his 7f win at Salisbury in May off 2lb lower; disappointing on both starts since but with possible excuses (early scrimmaging/1m) and he has proved himself over C&D; needs a second look.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On X Handicap
Spotlight: Close fourth over C&D in March and off the mark at Windsor (6f, good) in May; off 57 days before failing to figure at Wolverhampton (16-1) five weeks ago, but he's not ruled out.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On X Handicap
Spotlight: One of the youngsters in this field and he's had just four races, below-form sixth of 14 last time on handicap debut at Windsor (6f; 15-2); earlier efforts, including on Tapeta, means he can't be dismissed.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On X Handicap
OwnerName: G H Thompson &  S P C Woods
Spotlight: Suited by AW and won at Wolverhampton (6f maiden) in November, with two bits of form on Chelmsford Polytrack too; beaten a neck at Southwell (6f) in April but below form since over 6f, 7f and 1m, so others look more solid; wears headgear first time.

RaceName: British EBF & Sir Henry Cecil Galtres Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Made most for Listed win at Saint-Cloud last October and reappeared this May with a respectable Listed second in France, both 1m2f on soft; won over 1m3f in 2024 and she now looks worth a crack at 1m4f; first, though, she needs to bounce back after tailing off in an AW Group 3 (20-1) eight weeks ago.

RaceName: British EBF & Sir Henry Cecil Galtres Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Second off handicap marks of 79 and 81 this summer, so filling the same position in nine-runner Listed race at Newmarket (1m4f, good to firm) on latest outing was the first inkling that she might be able to hold her own at this level; wore cheekpieces on last two starts.

RaceName: British EBF & Sir Henry Cecil Galtres Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Ex-Polish filly who has won on soft; minor honours this term over 1m2f in handicap at Windsor (unlucky) and over 1m4f in both a Listed event at Pontefract (fourth of nine) and handicap at Ascot; needs to find a bit extra but has similar form to most in this field.

RaceName: British EBF & Sir Henry Cecil Galtres Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Tail flasher who has looked a bit tricky at times but she's also won four of her eight starts; did it well in a handicap at Ascot (good to firm) in May 2025 and, with Ryan Moore taking over, she then justified short-priced favouritism in last-gasp fashion in two hot AW handicaps at Lingfield last winter; those wins were 1m2f and she's unraced beyond that, but three siblings scored at 1m3f or 1m4f; absent since January but those last two 1m2f AW wins make her the clear form pick.

RaceName: British EBF & Sir Henry Cecil Galtres Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 3-6 for Ralph Beckett, including a 1m4f handicap win at Newmarket last October on good ground (previous wins were on heavy and good to soft); similar form this season in Ireland over 1m2f, 1m4f and 1m6f for new yard, without a win but the last two of those assignments were Group 3 (with cheekpieces enlisted) and she has a similar form chance to most in this line-up.

RaceName: British EBF & Sir Henry Cecil Galtres Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Won debut on good to soft, no impression in her one race on soft; 1m1f handicap winner here last September and, having finished well for fourth of 24 over 1m this season at Royal Ascot, she ran on into second of eight when trying 1m2f again in Group 3 at the Curragh on latest outing; races a bit freely but her dam was pretty useful at this trip; each-way form chance.

RaceName: British EBF & Sir Henry Cecil Galtres Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Showed she stays 1m4f well in two races on good to soft last autumn, latterly with a clearcut Listed win at Toulouse; well below form in her only start this season (start of May) but interesting if she's back on song.

RaceName: British EBF & Sir Henry Cecil Galtres Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Won at Newbury (1m, soft) on sole 2yo start and beaten about 3l in the Listed Cheshire Oaks at Chester (11.3f, good) on return; 22-1, stuck to her task well for a never-dangerous, 10l fourth of nine in the Oaks at Epsom (1m4f, good to soft) 11 weeks ago; off since but could have more improvement in her and 1m4f on rain-softened ground would seemingly hold no fears.

RaceName: British EBF & Sir Henry Cecil Galtres Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Long odds-on for her Pontefract novice win (1m, good; acts on good to soft) in June; close third of seven when 5-6 for a handicap at Windsor one month ago on the move up to 1m2f and she's by Australia, which boosts hopes for 1m4f; she has the lowest rating in this field, however.

RaceName: British EBF & Sir Henry Cecil Galtres Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Sister to connections' Pride Of Arras, last year's Dante and Great Voltigeur winner at this track; this filly's best effort has likewise been at York, when third in the Group 3 Musidora (10.2f, good) in May; however, tailing off in the Oaks at Epsom (good to soft; 18-1) and seventh of nine in Listed race at Newmarket, both 1m4f, weaken her case considerably; headgear is now enlisted.

RaceName: British EBF & Sir Henry Cecil Galtres Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Sister to 2022 Derby second Hoo Ya Mal; dual AW novice winner (1m/1m4f); runner-up in the Lingfield Oaks Trial (11.6f, good to firm) before fifth of 15 in the Italian Oaks (10.5f, good) and second to an impressive winner in Listed race at Hamilton (1m3f, good to firm), which were all useful form but she'll need to find a bit extra.

RaceName: British EBF & Sir Henry Cecil Galtres Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Hooded on all three starts; kicked off this summer with two seconds, on the strength of which she was 11-10 favourite at Ffos Las (1m4f, good) late last month in another maiden, which she proceeded to win by 13l after leading over 1f out; only four ran in that steadily run race and this is a very different proposition, but she strode clear in great style and looks useful.

RaceName: British EBF & Sir Henry Cecil Galtres Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Clearcut win from the front in a maiden at Killarney (11.3f, good) in her fourth race, having been second on soft the time before; came from midfield when short-headed by a stablemate in seven-runner Listed race at Gowran Park (1m4f, good; the third won a Group 3 next time) last month, producing another improved effort and making her a big player in these calculations.

RaceName: Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Has had plenty of racing since winning on the Rowley course (7f, good) under Chloe Lyons in May but he found something new when striding right away over this C&D (good to firm) on Saturday; due an 8lb rise so 3lb well in; much respected.

RaceName: Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: His win in July took C&D record to 3-4 (good to soft and good to firm); had a very awkward start here since and was soon tailed off (stablemate Cherry Cobbler was second) but, given his fine strike-rate here, he can't easily be left out.

RaceName: Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: His first win came over 7f (soft) but better at 1m now, getting up late to win on Wolverhampton AW when making his yard debut in January and finding only a subsequent winner too good at Ascot last month; out of sorts at Redcar since though and reverts to 7f with something to prove.

RaceName: Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Two narrow wins over 7f (good to firm) either side of apparently failing to stay 1m at Goodwood in June but he found just the one pace when sixth of 11 at Ascot last month and it remains to be seen whether he's still on a winning mark.

RaceName: Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Two course wins at 1m; two good efforts for new yard this year but a promising-looking run came to nothing when back over 1m at York last time; still worth a look returned to 7f in his first course run since last summer's win; first-time cheekpieces replace regular visor.

RaceName: Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Made all for 6f maiden win as 2yo; best form of 2026 when second of six at Sandown (7f) last month but he didn't repeat it there next time on return from wind surgery and has had a few chances off similar marks now.

RaceName: Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Soft-ground winner at 7f in France last June; big prices and well held over 7f and 1m for new yard, the latest after wind surgery, but she's dropped just 6lb and looks to have a way to go before she's well handicapped.

RaceName: Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Successful AW debut as 2yo but was up against it in a sales race next time (sole turf run); back on the AW since, running well in a 7f Chelmsford novice on final 2yo start and doing as well as could be expected on his recent belated reappearance; has a surface query back on turf but should have some potential off this mark.

RaceName: Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: He's won over 7f but his two July course wins came over 6f; well handicapped now and although his form seems to have slacked off since he went close over this C&D in June this is his first 7f run since; not ruled out.

RaceName: Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Lightly raced maiden; in good form in 7f Epsom handicaps, persevering well when runner-up latest, and although he has more to do in this higher grade with a stiffer test at the trip he can be on the premises.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap
Spotlight: The winner of two of her 11 starts, both over 5.7f at Bath on fast ground; only fourth back at Bath last time and she will need a career best to defy top weight; unplaced all four AW starts.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap
Spotlight: The winner of one of his 11 starts in Ireland, namely a 7f handicap at Dundalk in April; makes his stable debut at a realistic level and the betting should be informative after an 80-day break.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap
Spotlight: Some promise as a 2yo; struggled this year and although she is easing down the weights, the new blinkers and drop in trip need to have a transformative effect.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap
Spotlight: Ran his best race for Charles Hills when third of 12 in a 6f Kempton nursery 302 days ago; gelded during his absence and returns off a 2lb lower mark and with a hood fitted; interesting on stable debut (same owner).

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap
Spotlight: His two handicap runs have been unconvincing, including when tried in blinkers at Brighton (7f, good to firm) two weeks ago; drop to 6f not enough to tempt.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap
Spotlight: Seven-race maiden but she has been placed in 7f handicaps on her last two starts; has the pace to be effective back at 6f; still has time to deliver an improved showing.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap
Spotlight: Two course wins earlier in the year; running okay with quite being at his best this summer; on a competitive mark and he can't be discounted.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap
Spotlight: Unplaced in all five starts, including 7f handicaps on last two runs; edging down the weights and dropping in trip could help; not especially solid though.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap
Spotlight: Beat five rivals at Ffos Las (6f, good) in June but he has followed that with two heavy defeats; new blinkers need to turn things around.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap
Spotlight: He has offered more following wind and gelding operations, fourth over 7f here in May before a commanding front-running win at Wolverhampton (5f) last month; an 8lb rise unlikely to prove beyond him and he's a key player despite his wide stall.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap
Spotlight: 0-9 but he has run several good races in defeat this summer, most recently finishing third of eight at Leicester (6f, good to firm) four weeks ago; each-way shout once again.

RaceName: Sheahan's Pharmacy 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Showed good improvement for the addition of a visor at Dundalk in January when easily winning off 63 over 1m for former trainer Joseph O'Brien; okay efforts back there and at Leopardstown after that, but beaten 10.5l behind Harmani at Down Royal when last seen in May; Flat rating of 73 puts him in the mix on hurdling/stable debut.

RaceName: Sheahan's Pharmacy 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Tailed off at Ballinrobe on his debut in a similar contest ten days ago (2m1f, good, 100-1); unlikely.

RaceName: Sheahan's Pharmacy 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Best of three Flat runs came at Ballinrobe in May when an 11l fourth; trainer reported he scoped dirty post-race when tailed off at Galway last time; others preferred unless market support arrives for his hurdles bow.

RaceName: Sheahan's Pharmacy 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Massive prices and ran like it in three starts over hurdles this summer; similar story likely.

RaceName: Sheahan's Pharmacy 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Winless from 10 Flat starts and hasn't looked like the breakthrough was close in two recent starts over hurdles.

RaceName: Sheahan's Pharmacy 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Emphatically won a Down Royal handicap for Ger Lyons in May (1m3f, good); okay efforts in three runs since leave him with the top Flat rating in this field of 82 after eight starts; obvious danger to all provided he takes to this discipline.

RaceName: Sheahan's Pharmacy 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Tailed off here on Flat debut; hard to fancy after that.

RaceName: Sheahan's Pharmacy 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Has left moderate Flat form behind with runner-up finishes in two starts over hurdles; beaten a neck over C&D in July but needs to settle better on the basis of his 5.5l defeat at Ballinrobe last time; best hurdles form on offer here but vulnerable to one more talented coming off the Flat.

RaceName: Sheahan's Pharmacy 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: One of two for trainer; rated 54 on Flat after no wins from nine starts; ran his best race at this track last month when fourth; others preferred on hurdling debut.

RaceName: Sheahan's Pharmacy 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: One of two for trainer; won a Sligo Flat handicap off 71 in May but was 21l behind Harmani next time; just okay on C&D hurdles debut here and tailed off back on Flat at Galway last time; others have more compelling claims; new headgear.

RaceName: Sheahan's Pharmacy 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
OwnerName: Anthony Head & Stephen E McCarthy & Mrs Paul Shanahan
Spotlight: Easily won her seventh Flat start in a Down Royal handicap off 61 last time (1m5f, good); brings that positive form to hurdles now and should go well.

RaceName: Mews Hotel Ossett EBF Stallions Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: 7f Redcar debut scorer (good) in May; faded out of things in the Chesham at Royal Ascot next time but different proposition with sights lowered when pipping Dubai Champion (non-runner here on Wednesday) in 6f Glorious Goodwood nursery (good to firm); a 5lb rise demands further improvement but Group entries next month point to him being well regarded by his top stable; the draw could have been kinder.

RaceName: Mews Hotel Ossett EBF Stallions Nursery Handicap
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid
Spotlight: Second success when getting up close home on nursery debut at Doncaster (extended 6f; good to firm; first-time blinkers); excuses when only midfield in a 7f Glorious Goodwood nursery the following week; his mark still looks favourable on the Doncaster form and his stable won this two years ago.

RaceName: Mews Hotel Ossett EBF Stallions Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Won novices at Lingfield (7f, AW) and Ffos Las (extended 7f, good) this summer; the fact he's gone off at 13-8 or shorter on all three starts suggest he's highly thought of by his leading yard, as do Group entries next month; handily drawn and Billy Loughnane is on him rather than stablemate Mirzimaan; interesting.

RaceName: Mews Hotel Ossett EBF Stallions Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Justified market support with neck success at Ffos Las (6f, good) on debut and backed that up when second under a penalty at Salisbury (6f, good to firm) 30 days ago, keeping on well despite his jockey dropping his whip inside the final furlong; steps up to 7f for his nursery debut; another in the line-up who holds a Group entry next month.

RaceName: Mews Hotel Ossett EBF Stallions Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Progressing well, winning five-runner races (7f, good to firm) for a novice at Ayr and nursery at Doncaster in recent weeks; made all with something to spare at the latter track and a 5lb rise may not prevent another bold bid with the Ed Bethell stable in flying form; engaged in the Group 2 Champagne at Doncaster next month.

RaceName: Mews Hotel Ossett EBF Stallions Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Runner-up on all three starts; had Mia Fantasia in third at Ascot (7f, good to firm) on the second occasion and narrowly denied by Roosike at Southwell (7f, AW; now meets that rival on identical terms) last time; stall 21 could be tricky but Andrew Balding's excellent record in this race (three wins since 2021, including last year) makes him a must for the shortlist.

RaceName: Mews Hotel Ossett EBF Stallions Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Chepstow debut win in the spring came on good to soft, so he wouldn't have any issues should the forecast rain arrive; hasn't built on that significantly but he's one of a few in this line-up who didn't enjoy much luck in running in the Glorious Goodwood nursery over this trip last month and a Listed race was simply too much for him at Salisbury last month.

RaceName: Mews Hotel Ossett EBF Stallions Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Has improved for a step up to 7f, winning a maiden at Ayr (good to firm) and nursery at Thirsk (good) in recent weeks; further progress possible but it will be needed off this 5lb higher mark.

RaceName: Mews Hotel Ossett EBF Stallions Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Won a 6f novice at Nottingham (good) in early June; failed to fire in the Coventry at Royal Ascot but has bounced back with good seconds in 7f nurseries at Chester and Glorious Goodwood (a few of these rivals behind); didn't look entirely at ease on the course at Goodwood (hung right) and it's possible that this track will suit him better.

RaceName: Mews Hotel Ossett EBF Stallions Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Has raced just at 6f; too green on debut but took a significant step forward with his defeat of 17 rivals at Newbury (good to firm) last month; bettered that form and would have won with a clearer passage when only just failing to get up at Newcastle (AW) since; should have more to offer now moving up to 7f for his nursery debut but Billy Loughnane seemingly prefers stablemate Perfect Nation.

RaceName: Mews Hotel Ossett EBF Stallions Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: All starts over 7f on good to firm; took big step forward from debut fourth to Mia Fantasia when easily drawing clear by just over 7l at Brighton last month; backed that up when narrowly denied under a penalty at Yarmouth 18 days ago; looks on a competitive mark for his nursery debut.

RaceName: Mews Hotel Ossett EBF Stallions Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: First three starts over 6f, winning a Newcastle novice on the third; stepped up to 7f for his nursery debut and ran well for fifth (The Ginger Kid second) of 18 at Glorious Goodwood, albeit better positioned than some of today's reopposing rivals who finished behind him.

RaceName: Mews Hotel Ossett EBF Stallions Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: All runs over 7f on good to firm, overcoming a slow start to win comfortably at Carlisle on debut before third to Dr Rascal (Rising Tiger second) in novice at Ascot; on the back of those efforts he went off a hot favourite for a Glorious Goodwood nursery but didn't get the chance to show what he could do, meeting trouble on a couple of occasions and doing well to finish sixth of 18; that performance strongly suggests he can go close at the least off this mark with more luck in running.

RaceName: Mews Hotel Ossett EBF Stallions Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Beaten a fair way when placed on first two outings and took a good step forward when holding on determinedly from the reopposing Rising Tiger in novice at Southwell (7f, AW) 24 days ago; meets that rival on the same terms.

RaceName: Mews Hotel Ossett EBF Stallions Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Made it sixth time lucky when seeing off three rivals in a 7f Catterick nursery (good to firm) 29 days ago; that was his first attempt at this trip but he's 5lb higher in a significantly stronger race now; also drawn widest.

RaceName: Mews Hotel Ossett EBF Stallions Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Behind several of these at Glorious Goodwood and first-time cheekpieces need to make a big difference.

RaceName: Mews Hotel Ossett EBF Stallions Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Thrice-raced colt who has shown steady improvement over 6f, half-length second (Theheatison fourth) to a next-time-out winner when favourite for Windsor nursery (good to firm) most recently; bred to be suited by this step up in distance; Mia Fantasia looks the pick of the stable's four runners but no surprise were this one to play a prominent role.

RaceName: Mews Hotel Ossett EBF Stallions Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Bath novice win came over an extended 5f but he looked suited by the return to 7f when never-nearer third of seven in Newmarket nursery (good to firm) 12 days ago; needs to build on that.

RaceName: Mews Hotel Ossett EBF Stallions Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: His claims aren't obvious having finished well held in nurseries over 6f here (Big Cigar won) and 7f at Goodwood (behind five of these) on his last two starts; tongue tied first time; 3lb out of the handicap.

RaceName: Mews Hotel Ossett EBF Stallions Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Got up close home to make a successful start to his nursery career over 6f at Pontefract (good) 44 days ago and the runner-up gave that form a boost when winning at Lingfield on Monday; the return to 7f may prompt more improvement but he is running off 9lb higher now (including 4lb out of handicap).

RaceName: Racing Welfare Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Came from the rear to score on her reappearance at Windsor (11.5f, good to firm) in May; best effort since when 0.5l second to Society Girl over C&D (good to firm) three weeks ago; same mark today.

RaceName: Racing Welfare Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Not at his best lately (well-held last of three latest) but is 2lb lower than when scoring over this trip on good in the spring so a revival wouldn't surprise with Dylan Cunha among the winners.

RaceName: Racing Welfare Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Positive start for the Charlie Clover yard, readily landing a small-field affair at Lingfield (1m5f, good to firm) in June; better form when runner-up both starts since, latterly over 1m6f here on good to firm; should give another good account.

RaceName: Racing Welfare Apprentice Handicap
OwnerName: P Hickman And Lord Lloyd Webber
Spotlight: Best effort when third of six on 1m4f Salisbury handicap debut (good to firm) 26 days ago; a lightly raced profile provides hope that this well-bred sort may build on that.

RaceName: Racing Welfare Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: First success when making all to beat the reopposing Sibling Rivelry by 0.5l over C&D (good to firm) three weeks ago; only 2lb higher and doesn't face much obvious competition for the lead.

RaceName: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 95,000gns yearling, E210,000 Breeze Up; eighth foal; No Nay Never, half-sister to winners including 6f Group 2 winner Gustavus Weston and Listed-placed sprint winner Kape Moss; dam 1m AW winner

RaceName: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: E280,000 Y; first foal; by Wootton Bassett, dam French 1m 2yo winner, half-sister to German 1m4f Group 1 winner Sibayan, out of French 1m4f/1m6f Listed winner from family of Derby/Arc winner Sinndar.

RaceName: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: E50,000 Breeze Up purchase; ninth foal; half-sister by Blackbeard to six winners, notably Group 3 scorer Term Of Endearment; dam 7f 2yo/1m2f Listed winner by Montjeu; hooded for debut.

RaceName: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Eighth foal; Kingman filly is a sister to three winners, half-sister to three winners, including Listed scorer Georgeville (8.4f-1m2f inc Listed; 112) and Pacific Mission (Grade 1 placed), dam a Group 3 winner by Dansili.

RaceName: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
OwnerName: M Tabor & D Smith & Mrs J Magnier & Westerberg
Spotlight: Slow starter when sixth in a strong maiden at the Curragh; stable well represented here, with riding plans pointing to the Group 1-entered Miss Hong Kong as the number one.

RaceName: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 50-1 when running respectably over 6f at the Curragh on recent debut; open to improvement.

RaceName: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
OwnerName: Barnane Stud & Hollywood Stud Ireland Limited
Spotlight: Fourth foal; closely related to a winner in Italy; dam a Listed winner; decent pedigree.

RaceName: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: E72,000 Y; second foal; by Camelot; dam 7f AW winner (RPR 76), half-sister to winners Wigmore Hall (Canadian 1m4f Grade 1), Ocean Road (US 1m1f Grade 1) and Lady Liberty (German 1m2f Listed); noteworthy.

RaceName: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: E400,000 yearling; tenth foal; half-sister by Wootton Bassett to Group 1 Garswood (Prix Maurice de Gheest), Zagitova (Group-placed) and Frill; unraced dam closely related to 7f Group 3 winner Infallible (dam of 1m Group 1 winner Veracious)

RaceName: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
OwnerName: Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor
Spotlight: By Wootton Bassett out of Moyglare winner and dual Classic winner Love; made a promising introduction over 1m at this venue, keeping for second behind the favourite; just denied by her main market rival over 7f at Goodwood three weeks ago; will probably need further than this in time, but can make amends.

RaceName: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Might prefer further than this; was staying on late over C&D on debut four weeks ago, beaten 7l in eight (of 12); runner-up won easily at Gowran last week.

RaceName: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Has shown definite signs of winning potential in maidens here and at the Curragh; this will qualify her for handicaps.

RaceName: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Towards the back in races at Naas and Chepstow, cheekpieces fitted, faces tough task.

RaceName: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Second foal; half-sister by Kingman to 1m4f AW winner Bay Of Stars; dam was a course Listed winner over 1m4f; plenty of stamina on the dam's side.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Four 5f turf wins for this yard in 2025 and in good form this summer, doing well to get as close as she did from the widest draw at Chester two starts ago; however, she's 0-5 on the AW and it may be  significant that she hasn't run on sand since March 2025.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Multiple wins at 7f-1m in Ireland, including on Polytrack, but she hasn't looked well treated on turf in Britain; has a lower AW mark but still has enough to prove in her first run over 5f.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: 0-12 but she should find a race on the pick of her turf form this summer and she acts on Polytrack; should be suited by the return to 5f in her first AW handicap at the trip and has to be considered.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Losing run goes back to last September (5f, turf) but she ran creditably in better AW races than this earlier in the year and has won and gone well fresh in the past; interesting to see what another change of yard does for her; usually tongue tied but not today.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Lightly raced filly whose front-running effort petered out at Windsor two starts ago but she made all either side of that at Wetherby (extended 5f) and Ayr (5f); has a new challenge in only her second AW start (fair effort at Newcastle as a 2yo) but she may yet do better.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Best form when winning 5f Southwell AW maiden in March for Karl Burke; has not run to her mark in handicaps at Ffos Las and back at Southwell in two runs for this yard and likely needs more weight off her back.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Came closest to a first win when reeled in late after setting the pace over C&D last October; involved in another tight finish at Wolverhampton (5f) in February but not as good since, markedly so on turf in July; might yet come good with cheekpieces fitted and back at her best trip.

RaceName: GMIB Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won a valuable handicap hurdle at Galway last time (2m1f, good to yielding), under a good ride by today's jockey; that was a sixth hurdles win but none of those has ever come off a mark this high; not a surefire candidate to follow up.

RaceName: GMIB Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Flat winner; dual victories over hurdles include a C&D win; just 0.5l behind subsequent Galway Hurdle winner Putapoundinthejar at Bellewstown last month (2m1f, good), winner now rated 14lb higher; not a bad effort on the Flat at Galway last time (1m4f, yielding to soft); interesting.

RaceName: GMIB Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Maiden/novice wins during the summer of 2024; mostly disappointing since then, fell at Thurles when last seen in January; makes stable debut.

RaceName: GMIB Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Placed twice in points before placing in his opening two starts over hurdles; made the breakthrough in a 2m4f maiden hurdle here last time; shaped like he wanted further that day, so this drop back in trip may not help him on handicap bow.

RaceName: GMIB Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Bumper and maiden hurdle winner was out of form last season, beaten 27l+ in three starts over hurdles; hard to recommend.

RaceName: GMIB Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Chasing three wins in a row following dual victories at Cork over 2m1f on good ground following the application of a hood; up 8lb more but should be on the premises.

RaceName: GMIB Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won back-to-back hurdle races in August/September on good ground (including C&D maiden hurdle); creditable C&D fourth on seasonal return in May off 1lb higher but below that at Listowel next time (2m, yielding); okay fourth of seven on chasing debut here last time; remains 5lb higher than his last win.

RaceName: GMIB Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won a Tipperary maiden hurdle in 2024 (2m1f, soft); creditable third at Ballinrobe in May (2m, good) off 2lb lower and okay effort on chasing debut at Roscommon last time when a distant third; place chance.

RaceName: GMIB Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Has lost way since winning a 2m5f maiden hurdle at Sligo in August last year; tongue-tie added to cheekpieces but current form a concern.

RaceName: GMIB Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Is 0-6 over hurdles but has taken the runner-up spot in his last two runs, in a Ballinrobe handicap off 100 (2m2f, good) and in a Cork maiden earlier this month (2m2f, good); 1lb wrong here but he has found some consistency.

RaceName: British EBF Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Acts on most ground; has won three handicaps at Musselburgh this season and gained her first Listed success when scoring at Chester (7f, good) in June, but she was below that level at Pontefract (1m) last month; has a better draw than she did when down the field in this contest last year but is now 11lb higher than when last seen in handicap company.

RaceName: British EBF Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Unraced on ground softer than good; can front-run; sixth in the Group 3 Nell Gwyn on her reappearance before finishing down the field in the 1,000 Guineas and fading into fifth in a French Group 2 (1m, good; her best form); now drops back to 7f after failing to settle over 1m in the Sandringham at Royal Ascot two months ago but stall 17 isn't ideal.

RaceName: British EBF Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Best efforts have been on soft/heavy ground, including when going close in a Group 3 at Ayr (6f) last September and winning a Listed contest at Doncaster (6f) when last seen 299 days ago; has since had wind surgery and steps up to 7f for her reappearance; pedigree suggests she'll stay but she may need this return to action.

RaceName: British EBF Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: All three turf wins have been on good ground, including two Group-race successes at San Siro over 1m, most recently in the Italian 1,000 Guineas in May; below her best in three starts since and may be high in the weights for now; drops back to 7f with cheekpieces applied.

RaceName: British EBF Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Unproven on ground slower than good; 3yo filly who seems to have been well suited by dropping back to 7f in cheekpieces, landing a six-runner handicap at Yarmouth (good to firm) and making all at Newmarket (good to firm) 19 days ago; another 6lb higher in this more competitive race but can't be dismissed lightly in her current form.

RaceName: British EBF Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Well held over 1m on turf on her first two outings (good) but she posted an improved effort when winning a Wolverhampton maiden (7f, AW) last month; overcame a wide trip to follow up on her handicap debut over that same C&D 20 days ago, holding off the late challenge of the runner-up, but she now needs to transfer that improvement to turf.

RaceName: British EBF Fillies' Handicap
OwnerName: Jastar Capital Ltd & Rancho Temescal Thoroughbred Partners
Spotlight: Acts on soft-good to firm ground; off the mark when winning at Windsor (6f) on second start and ran well when second of eight in a Listed event at Lingfield (7f, AW) in February; then left Richard Hughes and has since struggled in two starts in the USA (6.5f/1m); now makes her handicap debut on her first start back for this trainer.

RaceName: British EBF Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Unraced on ground slower than good; landed a handicap at Haydock (7f) last May in convincing style before a good fourth in the Sandringham (1m); returned from 11 months off with a solid fifth of 13 at Thirsk (1m; first-time tongue-tie) in May but well beaten since in the Kensington Palace back at Royal Ascot (1m); drops back in trip, needing to bounce back.

RaceName: British EBF Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Sole win came in a novice at Leicester (6f, good) last October and second behind Lam Yai in a Listed event at Doncaster (6f, heavy) next time; posted her best effort on RPRs when sixth of 13 in Group 3 here over 6f last month but she was below her best in a handicap at Ascot (6f, good to firm) 12 days ago; down 2lb but others look stronger.

RaceName: British EBF Fillies' Handicap
