Spotlight: Probably acts on soft ground; two wins from 18 starts, the most recent win at Ripon (6f, good; first-time cheekpieces) in May off a 5lb lower mark than today's; ran a solid race when fourth of 20 at Goodwood (6f, good) last time but she doesn't look to be crying out for this step back up in trip and her draw could have been kinder.

RaceName: British EBF Fillies' Handicap
OwnerName: Julie And David R Martin And Dan Hall
Spotlight: Comfortable win on her debut at Beverley (7.5f, soft) last September and second of eight in a Newbury Listed race (7f, soft) the following month; disappointed under a penalty on her reappearance at Leicester (1m, good to firm) in May and now makes her handicap debut having been off again since; will appreciate any rain that falls.

RaceName: British EBF Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Unraced on ground slower than good since her debut; half-sister to Queen Elizabeth ll Jubilee Stakes winner Almeraq; placed on her first two outings this season (6f/7f) before doubling her win tally with a neck success at Carlisle (7f, good to firm) in May; strong in the betting when only fifth in a Listed race there in June, but she now returns to handicap company and should still be capable of progress.

RaceName: British EBF Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Acts on good to soft but unraced on slower; without a win since her debut in June 2024 (Hilary Needler) but she has posted some good efforts, including when a 1l second of 11 at Thirsk (1m, good) in May; however, she hasn't been at her best in her two starts since and was well beaten in this race last year, albeit off an 11lb higher mark.

RaceName: British EBF Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Unraced on ground slower than good; off the mark in a maiden at Chester (7f) on second start and followed up narrowly in a novice at Wetherby (7f; second has won since); ran well behind an improving rival on handicap debut at Newmarket (7f) last month but was below that level at Goodwood (6f) three weeks ago; stepping back up in trip should suit.

RaceName: British EBF Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Caught the eye on her debut over 7f (good to soft) before making all in a three-runner novice at Newmarket (1m, good to firm) and following that with a comfortable success in another small field at Yarmouth (1m, good to firm) last month; this race is much more competitive but she doesn't lack a turn of foot, which bodes well for this drop back in trip, and this well-related filly is a leading contender on her handicap debut.

RaceName: British EBF Fillies' Handicap
OwnerName: Mrs Frank Barry & Mrs Luke Barry
Spotlight: Unraced on ground slower than good; made a winning yard debut in a Southwell novice (6f, AW) in January and built on that when sixth of eight in a Listed event at Lingfield (7f, AW); had failed to beat a rival in two starts on turf prior to finishing a close third of four on handicap debut at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm) four weeks ago, but this is a more competitive contest.

RaceName: British EBF Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Unraced on ground slower than good; off the mark when winning a Chelmsford novice (6f, AW) in January and has since won twice in handicap company with this hood applied, most recently off a steady pace at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) last month; solid effort at Goodwood (6f, good; Woohoo was second) last time and she has each-way claims returned to this trip.

RaceName: British EBF Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Best form has been on good/good to firm ground; dual winner last year (5.5f/5f) and she's been runner-up in four of her five starts this year, including when going close here in a 0-100 over 6f in June; her pedigree gives the impression this step up in trip will be no problem and she's a contender.

RaceName: British EBF Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Unproven on ground slower than good to soft; five-time winner (5f/6f), the most recent win at Musselburgh in April off a 10lb lower mark than today's; second in each of her last five starts, including when ahead of a few of today's rivals at Goodwood (6f, good) two starts back, but now tries 7f for the first time off a career-high mark.

RaceName: British EBF Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: 0-4 as 2yo but improved form since a 207-day break, making all at Lingfield (6f, AW) before following up at Thirsk on her turf debut (6f, good to firm); leaves the impression she has more to offer but now steps back up in trip in a deeper race off this 8lb higher mark (2lb out of the handicap).

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 6,500gns yearling; second foal; Too Darn Hot colt, unraced dam closely related to a 5f winner, half-sister to Richmond Stakes winner Prolific and Deal Breaker (US 1m stakes).

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Never in the hunt over 5f at Cork on debut; pedigree suggests 7f will suit better.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Slowly away and never involved first time out at Gowran; unlikely to feature.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
OwnerName: Gary Devlin & C G Bryson & Kevin Osborne
Spotlight: Hampered at the start at Galway, made some late progress; has potential for improvement and enjoys a slight edge over Romance.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: E25,000 foal purchase, retained at E20,000 as a yearling; sixth foal; half-brother by Awtaad to two winners; dam unraced half-sister to Listed winners Kingsgate Prince and Captain Ramius.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Stepped up from a satisfactory debut in a 17-runner Navan event when third at Sligo; would have been closer but for becoming unbalanced at a track crossing point around two furlongs down; should not be far away.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Mid-field run at Roscommon gives him something to build on; plenty of improvement needed.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Big price first time out at Gowran; slowly away and unable to make any impact.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Showed little on his first two starts; was able to dictate in a 6f Fairyhouse maiden and gave a much-improved display to take second; has picked up valuable experience in nurseries, second to a well-handicapped runner at the Curragh, fair fourth at Galway; the most appealing of those that have run.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Has failed to beat a single opponent in races here and at Galway; can be ruled out.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Sent off at 66-1 on debut at Roscommon, shaped with promise, staying on in the closing stages for a 6l fifth behind subsequent Listed winner Dancing Destiny; failed to match that form at Galway, when finished behind Sovreigns Joy.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 1,000gns yearling; fourth foal; Palace Pier filly, dam French Group-placed 1m winner is a sister to winners.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Did not show much on first two starts; took a step in the right direction when a staying-on sixth of 17 at Navan, in front of The Green Helmet (seventh); however, confidence is dented by her eclipse in a Curragh nursery, never looked like featuring, last of eight.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Failed to make much impression in a decent maiden at Down Royal; several winners have emerged from that race; may do better now.

RaceName: Racing TV Club Day Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Useful Irish 4yo who won twice over 2m in May and was creditable third over that trip in Listed contest at last month's Galway festival (good ground); hiked up in trip here; will be tough to beat if stamina holds out.

RaceName: Racing TV Club Day Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Unable to justify favouritism when only third of six in Market Rasen bumper on rules debut in June but comfortably won Uttoxeter maiden hurdle (2m4f, good) by over 7l last month, and should have a lot more to offer.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Novice Hurdle
Spotlight: One of two for trainer; readily justified favouritism to get off the mark at the fourth time of asking in a 2m6f Cartmel maiden hurdle in May and was found a good opportunity to follow up in a novice contest back at Cartmel, where he duly did by 20l; the fact Kennedy rides Brother Walfrid is off-putting.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Novice Hurdle
Spotlight: One of two for trainer; second in a Fairyhouse maiden hurdle on stable debut in April before a lesser bumper run; was happier back over obstacles when winning a 2m3f Punchestown maiden hurdle in June; must bounce back from a disappointing Galway (2m5f, good) effort last month, but Kennedy stays loyal.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Novice Hurdle
Spotlight: Fairyhouse maiden hurdle winner was pulled up on handicap debut off a mark of 113 in April; looks vulnerable at this level.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Novice Hurdle
Spotlight: Belied odds of 100-1 to make a winning start in a 2m3f mares' maiden hurdle at Cork; proved it wasn't a fluke when a neck in front of Pets Georgina at Kilbeggan to retain unbeaten record (3m, good to yielding); these are deeper waters so must improve.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Novice Hurdle
Spotlight: Solid placed graded form in France on testing ground; shed the maiden tag for this stable at Ludlow in February (2m5f, soft); decent effort on good ground in the mares' novice hurdle at Cheltenham but was below best at Punchestown next time; creditable effort over 2m5f here last time, and extra trip should suit; well treated at weights here and big chance.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Novice Hurdle
Spotlight: Followed up a Sligo bumper success by easily landing a C&D mares' maiden hurdle; too keen at Kilbeggan last time when well beaten upped to 3m1f in a conditions hurdle; prior to that she looked like a mare on the improve and foolish to discount.

RaceName: Unio Employee Benefits Handicap
Spotlight: Gained second career win at Down Royal in May (7f, good); lost form before regaining it to record a long-priced win on the second of two Galway festival starts; possibly vulnerable.

RaceName: Unio Employee Benefits Handicap
Spotlight: Landed back-to-back handicaps over C&D last year, including this race; placed twice over 1m subsequently; below best on first two runs this year; step in right direction with staying-on sixth at Fairyhouse; big chance after fifth in Naas race won by Zheleznaya Dama.

RaceName: Unio Employee Benefits Handicap
Spotlight: Placed in three maidens, soundly beaten on only handicap start; seasonal/stable debut and best watched in the circumstances.

RaceName: Unio Employee Benefits Handicap
Spotlight: Winner of two of his four starts this season, rising an aggregate 20lb from a basement mark; gave another bright display when fourth behind today's rival Faoladh at Galway.

RaceName: Unio Employee Benefits Handicap
Spotlight: Showed promise at two, notably when second in a 6f maiden at Navan; one decent run over 5f at the same venue this season, overall form is unconvincing.

RaceName: Unio Employee Benefits Handicap
Spotlight: Gained the sixth win of his career at Roscommon this time last year; 7lb lower now, but this season's form offers limited hope.

RaceName: Unio Employee Benefits Handicap
Spotlight: Not in the first six in three outings since incurring a sharp rise for a Gowran win in May; others preferred.

RaceName: Unio Employee Benefits Handicap
Spotlight: Sole win in 11 starts came on AW in maiden over 7f last October; well held in handicaps; towards the rear in Naas event dominated by Zheleznaya Dama and Bear Right.

RaceName: Unio Employee Benefits Handicap
Spotlight: Weak form in early-season maidens; well supported on handicap debut at Galway, was left with plenty to do after suffering interference out of the stalls; stayed on to some effect; less exposed than many of these; has a live chance.

RaceName: Unio Employee Benefits Handicap
Spotlight: Has made the frame in her last five starts in handicaps from 7f to 1m on varying ground; beaten favourite when third over C&D last month, doing well after losing her position early; neck second to Zheleznaya Dama at Naas on latest; does not need to improve much.

RaceName: Unio Employee Benefits Handicap
Spotlight: Had an off day at Dundalk last time; otherwise never out of the first four in handicaps; sole win was gained over 6f on AW but has stayed effectively over further than this on turf.

RaceName: Unio Employee Benefits Handicap
Spotlight: Good third in a nursery in September; saddle slipped at Cork; back on track with fifth at Limerick; gave way late on when second at Killarney; held on for a front-running win from Bear Right at Naas; not certain to uphold the form.

RaceName: Unio Employee Benefits Handicap
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan
Spotlight: Never closer than tenth in three outings; most recent run was in a claimer; hard to fancy.

RaceName: Unio Employee Benefits Handicap
Spotlight: Maiden raced mostly on AW for Natalia Lupini, fair form at up to 1m, placed three times; best of three runs for this stable when fourth over 5f at Down Royal.

RaceName: Unio Employee Benefits Handicap
Spotlight: Veteran winner of 14 races (11 on AW); respectable form in recent months, highlighted by a Roscommon second; another solid display when fifth of 17 here a fortnight ago, on the heels of runner-up Jazzit (second reserve) with Gordon Bennett among those behind.

RaceName: Unio Employee Benefits Handicap
Spotlight: Best form in 2022, winning three times in a July-to-September spell, and rising to a career-high mark of 94; frustrating in recent seasons; joined Peter Fahey late last year after a claiming-race third on AW; stumbled out of the stalls here two weeks ago on reappearance, left with too much to do; capable of better.

RaceName: Happy 70th Birthday Helen Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Seemingly aided by first-time cheekpieces when close third at Uttoxeter (2m4f, good to soft) in March, her fourth run after a long layoff, but was disappointing favourite on next outing; goes without headgear here; needs to up her game.

RaceName: Happy 70th Birthday Helen Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Did not need to improve to justify skinny odds in Warwick maiden (2m3f, good) in May, his third start over hurdles, and was not discredited when second to useful rival at Cartmel (2m6f, good) last month; should have some progress to come in handicaps; likely contender.

RaceName: Happy 70th Birthday Helen Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Low-mileage mare with 2-5 strike-rate for current stable, the latter win gained in first-time cheekpieces at Worcester (2m4f, good) in June; weakened into fourth of 16 (behind Torrent) after travelling strongly for a long way at Uttoxeter (2m7f, good) last month but this slightly sharper test might suit her better and she remains of interest.

RaceName: Happy 70th Birthday Helen Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Seemingly on the downgrade now but stayed on for creditable third of 16 when upped to 2m7f at Uttoxeter (good) last month and gets another chance off the same mark here; a possible.

RaceName: Happy 70th Birthday Helen Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won Huntingdon maiden (2m3f, good) in March and was placed in her first two handicaps, latterly when second at Newton Abbot (2m2f, good) last month; could have untapped potential over this new trip; respected.

RaceName: Thorn Plant Hire Beginners Chase
Spotlight: Dual hurdle winner up to 3m and is rated 125 in that sphere; made a sound chasing debut at Galway after 92 days away and has to be considered with improvement to come from that.

RaceName: Thorn Plant Hire Beginners Chase
Spotlight: Won over hurdles in France on his second start but was well beaten on stable debut in a competitive Punchestown novice hurdle; quickly sent over fences but can't be ruled out; the market might guide.

RaceName: Thorn Plant Hire Beginners Chase
Spotlight: Maiden is rated 100 over hurdles and was well beaten on chasing debut at Tramore a week ago; cheekpieces added but not easy to fancy.

RaceName: Thorn Plant Hire Beginners Chase
Spotlight: One of two runners for yard; point and maiden hurdle winner is rated 117 in the latter sphere; fine second on chasing debut to a useful rival last year but has a long absence to overcome; the market might indicate level of readiness.

RaceName: Thorn Plant Hire Beginners Chase
Spotlight: Second runner for yard; point winner got off the mark over hurdles at Punchestown (3m) in May and posted decent runs in novice races twice since; one to consider on chasing debut with cheekpieces retained.

RaceName: Thorn Plant Hire Beginners Chase
Spotlight: Bumper winner got off the mark over hurdles in a Fairyhouse handicap in February; found life tougher off higher marks and was well beaten on chasing debut at Galway; others preferred.

RaceName: Thorn Plant Hire Beginners Chase
Spotlight: Won a 2m6f maiden hurdle at this track last year before a poor run at Galway; posted solid efforts in both chase runs earlier this year, including back here; rated 124 and should go well getting the 7lb mares' allowance.

RaceName: Harry Potter Droneart Show Handicap
Spotlight: All three wins since September and he opened his AW account at Southwell (1m4f, Tapeta) in October; posted a career best when scoring at that track (1m6f) in April but he made no impact in two starts the following month; returns from three-month break.

RaceName: Harry Potter Droneart Show Handicap
Spotlight: His six wins, including two here, have all been gained over further; won at Redcar (2m) on his penultimate start and his latest fifth over 1m6f wasn't a bad effort; this is winnable if he handles the drop back in trip.

RaceName: Harry Potter Droneart Show Handicap
OwnerName: Mr & Mrs G F Hall Racing
Spotlight: Dual winner although the latest of them came here (1m2f) in 2023; regularly in the frame, however, including when fourth at Carlisle (1m3f) last month and third over 2m at Catterick (also good to firm) a fortnight ago; capable of having a say.

RaceName: Harry Potter Droneart Show Handicap
Spotlight: All three wins have come here (1m2f-1m4f); yet to recapture his best for this yard and he looked to wonder whether he fancied leaving the stalls on his return from 146-day break at Catterick a fortnight ago.

RaceName: Harry Potter Droneart Show Handicap
Spotlight: First two Flat runs for this yard were fairly encouraging, beaten 3l over C&D in June and second of 11 at Pontefract (1m4f, good) the following month; lacked the gears at Musselburgh last time but he's still of some interest.

RaceName: Harry Potter Droneart Show Handicap
Spotlight: In good form on AW in the spring and she won at Wolverhampton (1m4f, Tapeta) in April; beaten 14l on turf in June and 23l on her return to AW three weeks ago, however; needs to get back on track but that's not beyond the realms.

RaceName: Harry Potter Droneart Show Handicap
Spotlight: He has been beaten increasingly big margins in three handicaps; new cheekpieces have some work to do.

RaceName: Harry Potter Droneart Show Handicap
Spotlight: 28-race maiden but he has been running with credit, finishing in the frame on his last eight starts; acts on AW and he makes more appeal than some.

RaceName: Harry Potter Droneart Show Handicap
Spotlight: Two Lingfield AW wins (1m4f) for Mick Channon in 2021 and he also nabbed a handicap hurdle for Ben Pauling in 2023; some fair runs without winning for this yard but he has not been at his best since returning from a 406-day absence this season; career-low mark and he lost a shoe last time so worth a market check.

RaceName: Harry Potter Droneart Show Handicap
Spotlight: 43-race maiden who is 3lb out of the handicap.

RaceName: Harry Potter Droneart Show Handicap
OwnerName: G C Gale & Stuart Brown & Diane Stewart
Spotlight: Seven-race maiden; both 1m4f runs in May were respectable and she may not have been suited by the soft ground when well beaten over 1m6f in June; has her second go on AW from a reduced mark and it's still relatively early days.

RaceName: Harry Potter Droneart Show Handicap
Spotlight: In typical yard style he cracked off three quick qualifying runs (7f-1m); now enters handicaps up sharply in trip in a race that's begging to be won; betting should be very informative.

RaceName: Harry Potter Droneart Show Handicap
Spotlight: He had three qualifying runs over 6f in the spring before being gelded; made handicap debut over 1m2f at Ayr last month but he was uneasy in the market and never threatened; first-time cheekpieces worn that day are swapped for blinkers; still early days ahead of this further step up in trip.

RaceName: Bet With Tote On Racing & Sports Irish EBF Vinnie Roe Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Lightly-raced son of Frankel; gelded after finishing second to an odds-on shot in 1m2f Cork maiden in May, having run green; one-time Irish Derby entry left an impression he would stay this far with a smooth 1m4f win at Galway; progressive sort is out of a half-sister to St Leger winner Brian Boru.

RaceName: Bet With Tote On Racing & Sports Irish EBF Vinnie Roe Stakes (Listed Race)
OwnerName: Al Shaqab Racing & Stall Perlen AB
Spotlight: Twice runner-up before winning a C&D maiden in May; well beaten when favourite on handicap debut in the King George V Stakes at Royal Ascot (won by a stablemate); looked short of pace when third of eight in a 1m4f handicap at Goodwood; extra two furlongs should help.

RaceName: Bet With Tote On Racing & Sports Irish EBF Vinnie Roe Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Modest form at up to 1m before a runaway success when stepped up in trip at Killarney; promoted a punitive 17lb for that success over just short of 1m4f; faces a tough task at this level.

RaceName: Bet With Tote On Racing & Sports Irish EBF Vinnie Roe Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Consistent apart from a poor Navan run in May; bounced back from that reverse to win the Ulster Derby over 1m5f at Down Royal in June; maintained progress with a Galway festival win, defying a big burden in a lower handicap grade; stays well.

RaceName: Bet With Tote On Racing & Sports Irish EBF Vinnie Roe Stakes (Listed Race)
OwnerName: Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor
Spotlight: Holds a big chance in theory, though possibly flattered by a juvenile rating of 105 acquired after a four-race campaign, highlighted by a Galway maiden win; beaten favourite when fourth of eight in a high-class edition of the 1m1f Eyrefield Stakes won by Christmas Day; ended with a low-key display in a Group 1 at Saint-Cloud; unknown quantity as a stayer.

RaceName: Bet With Tote On Racing & Sports Irish EBF Vinnie Roe Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Unraced at two; showed plenty of improvement to land a 1m5f Ballinrobe maiden on his third start; met trouble in running in Navan race won by the smart Limestone; may struggle to reverse Down Royal handicap form with Madbadanddangerous.

RaceName: Bet With Tote On Racing & Sports Irish EBF Vinnie Roe Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Some promise in two runs as a juvenile; improved from his seasonal debut here to win a Curragh maiden, both over 1m2f; did well on the latter occasion as he had to wait for room; backed that up with victory in a four-runner event over 1m5f here four weeks ago; speedy pedigree on the dam's side, stamina derived from his sire.

RaceName: Bet With Tote On Racing & Sports Irish EBF Vinnie Roe Stakes (Listed Race)
OwnerName: Mrs Richard Henry & Mrs John Magnier
Spotlight: Won Dundalk handicaps over 1m and extended 1m2f in the spring; has remained dependable on turf; however, she was no match for Wyman here last month and faces a tough task on these terms.

RaceName: Bet With Tote On Racing & Sports Irish EBF Vinnie Roe Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Promoted a total of 24lb in the ratings for a Down Royal hat-trick; steps into a different league, needs to find considerably more to pose a serious threat.

RaceName: Brian And Sheila Vaughan Memorial Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Exploited reduced hurdle mark when winning narrowly over about 2m6f (if additional yardage is included) at Market Rasen (good) in May and remains very well handicapped on older chase form but he's not as good as he was and others have more appealing profiles.

RaceName: Brian And Sheila Vaughan Memorial Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Quirky front-runner who began last season's hat-trick with an emphatic success in this race (good to firm); made low-key reappearance over hurdles in March and has been off for another five months since but not out of this if back in prime form.

RaceName: Brian And Sheila Vaughan Memorial Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Front-runner who is 2-3 since fitted with a visor this season, with both wins gained over 2m6f here (good to firm); may not have things all his own way today and this drop back in trip is probably not ideal but further progress is not out of the question.

RaceName: Brian And Sheila Vaughan Memorial Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Progressive 6yo with 3-5 strike-rate over fences, including two 2m1f course wins this season; ran big race when close third behind Sir Tivo here (2m1f, good to firm) last month and could still have a bigger performance in him over this longer trip.

RaceName: Brian And Sheila Vaughan Memorial Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Miss D Sellars & Exors Of Mrs Ic Sellars
Spotlight: Gained both chase wins over 2m4f; bumped into progressive rival when second at Hexham (1m7f, good) two starts ago and travelled well until stamina ebbed away over 3m at Perth last month; remains on a workable mark; can make his presence felt.

RaceName: Brian And Sheila Vaughan Memorial Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Front-running veteran who is well suited by good or faster ground and battled well to score over 2m1f here last month, his 12th chase win; not sure to be ideally suited by today's longer trip but no surprise if he makes another bold bid.

RaceName: Easyfix Equine Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Dual hurdles winner in 2024 on soft added a chase win over an extended 2m4f here in May (good to yielding) off 94; hasn't looked like winning in three runs since (one over hurdles) and was tailed off over fences at Wexford last time in an eight-runner event (2m3f, good); hopes rest on the fact he drops back into same class for first time that saw him win here in May.

RaceName: Easyfix Equine Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Is 1-13 over fences with the win coming over C&D last summer off 91 (yielding to soft); hard to predict this term with some okay runs in defeat interspersed with poor efforts; his run at Galway was one of the latter when tailed off over fences but not a bad effort over hurdles here on penultimate; others preferred.

RaceName: Easyfix Equine Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Veteran hasn't won since August 2024; tailed off here in July, a run sandwiched between two pulled-up finishes; new headgear not enough to tempt now back over fences.

RaceName: Easyfix Equine Handicap Chase
OwnerName: Aiden Larkin & John Larkin & Paudie Dowling & Kenneth Fox
Spotlight: Made the breakthrough when winning a Roscommon handicap chase off 90 in June (2m6f, yielding to soft); chased home Cullenwaine over C&D next time when 15l behind; tailed off back at Roscommon last time (3m1f) when didn't appear to stay the trip on soft ground.

RaceName: Easyfix Equine Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Doubled his hurdles tally when successful by a neck at Roscommon last month (3m, good); rated 3lb below that winning mark over fences and he has placed on a couple of occasions from nine chase starts; one of the likelier candidates.

RaceName: Easyfix Equine Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Point winner whose best run came at Sligo in June when beaten 3.5l into third in extended 3m1f hurdle; not at same level in two subsequent outings over hurdles; back over fences now, but previous five starts in this sphere were moderate; blinkers on.

RaceName: Easyfix Equine Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Hurdle winner at Ballinrobe in 2025 got off the mark over fences over C&D last month in ready fashion (good to yielding); raised 8lb but was best of the rest when chasing home an easy winner at Roscommon last time (2m6f, soft); up 1lb more but should be thereabouts.

RaceName: Easyfix Equine Handicap Chase
Spotlight: His best hurdles form for Charles Byrnes seems long gone and he's now regressive; 12l behind Tropical Image in a six-runner 2m3f Listowel beginners' chase last time.

RaceName: Easyfix Equine Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Soundly beaten in both his points and the same story on sole chase start under rules in a beginners' at Tramore in October (2m5f, yielding); 0-12 over hurdles but has some placed form this season.

RaceName: Easyfix Equine Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Winning hurdler is 0-12 over fences; ran okay in handicap chases at Clonmel and Wexford over 2m7f/3m2f earlier this year; well beaten over 2m2f at Galway last time (good); may want it softer.

RaceName: Easyfix Equine Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Fine run in a 2m3f Listowel beginners' on penultimate when a close runner-up; didn't back it up over C&D last time when beaten 26l; 1lb drop not enough to tempt.

RaceName: Easyfix Equine Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Modest strike rate of 2-22 over fences but was on a real going day over C&D last time, blowing the field apart by 15l (good to yielding); up 9lb for that, but if he's in the same form he has a huge chance; overall record suggests that's no sure thing though.

RaceName: Easyfix Equine Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Maiden in all spheres after 34 starts, but was second at Downpatrick in June off 1lb higher (3m, good); sent off favourite up in grade at Wexford next time (2m7f, good), but was a modest third; well beaten over C&D latest; others preferred.

RaceName: Trusted Betting Site Reviews Gambling.com Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (GBB)
Spotlight: Drops back from 1m; too free when a beaten favourite on debut but made no mistake with a comfortable 4l success at Nottingham (again market leader) and she's looking a good prospect.

RaceName: Trusted Betting Site Reviews Gambling.com Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (GBB)
Spotlight: Had wind surgery prior to finishing comfortably held in two bumpers.

RaceName: Trusted Betting Site Reviews Gambling.com Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (GBB)
Spotlight: In rear throughout on her debut at Wolverhampton (6f) but there was no fluke about her 125-1 success there over 7f as she travelled well before clinging on to repel a subsequent Newmarket winner; has to be taken seriously; Molly Keegan-Price was aboard that day.

RaceName: Trusted Betting Site Reviews Gambling.com Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (GBB)
Spotlight: 250-1 when completely tailed off over this trip at Ripon three weeks ago.

RaceName: Trusted Betting Site Reviews Gambling.com Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (GBB)
Spotlight: Ran to a modest level in one AW run over 6f for Harry Charlton and sold on for 5,500gns.

RaceName: Trusted Betting Site Reviews Gambling.com Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (GBB)
Spotlight: Out of a Listed 6f winner but has shown pretty much nothing in two 7f races at Redcar.

RaceName: Trusted Betting Site Reviews Gambling.com Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (GBB)
Spotlight: Fourth foal; half-sister to winners Archduke Ferdinand (6f-1m; RPR 94) and Lorna B (6f; 86); dam 1m/9.4f winner (81); would need to see market confidence behind her.

RaceName: Trusted Betting Site Reviews Gambling.com Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (GBB)
Spotlight: Changed yards after debut and was always behind in a small field at Ripon last month.

RaceName: Trusted Betting Site Reviews Gambling.com Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (GBB)
Spotlight: Fourth of eight behind a well-bred winner at Redcar (7f) and she was getting the hang of things late on (beaten just under 8l); improvement seems likely.

RaceName: Money Back Daily Specials With Tote.ie Handicap
Spotlight: Much improved this year, recording wins at Navan, Ballinrobe and over just shy of this trip at Limerick in June; held off career-high marks last twice, trip possibly too far at Killarney and in Galway premier handicap; drops back in grade so respected, but this ground may be on the quick side.

RaceName: Money Back Daily Specials With Tote.ie Handicap
Spotlight: Hasn't added to Bellewstown maiden win of last summer although creditable handicap placings last month at Tramore and Ballinrobe; reportedly saddle slipped leaving stalls at Gowran on latest so that run forgiven; others look better handicapped.

RaceName: Money Back Daily Specials With Tote.ie Handicap
Spotlight: Dual AW winner whose turf win came over 1m6f on heavy at Listowel last year; back from hurdling campaign last season and stablemate of top-weight may just need this.

RaceName: Money Back Daily Specials With Tote.ie Handicap
Spotlight: Just 1m4f AW maiden win to his name but arrives on the back of two fine runs on turf, had the run of the race when pipped over 1m6f at Fairyhouse (rated race) and again made plenty of use of when third in 1m3f Naas handicap early this month; definite claims back up in trip.

RaceName: Money Back Daily Specials With Tote.ie Handicap
Spotlight: Useful juvenile hurdler last season reappeared from six months' absence when well-backed favourite on flat handicap debut at Galway festival, not quite getting home over 2m1f, having led home turn, finishing a good third of 19; 3lb higher but likely major player back slightly in trip.

RaceName: Money Back Daily Specials With Tote.ie Handicap
Spotlight: Much improved when upped to 1m4f, rattling off a hat-trick of wins, at Cork, here and the Curragh; didn't do himself justice at Galway when keen but remains of interest.

RaceName: Money Back Daily Specials With Tote.ie Handicap
Spotlight: Back-to-back Dundalk wins in the spring, and close second at Dundalk last month; previously put up his best turf effort of the season when close third to Darius Dark over 1m4f at the Curragh; steps up in grade.

RaceName: Money Back Daily Specials With Tote.ie Handicap
Spotlight: Two flat wins in 2022 included here over 1m7f; long losing stretch since and not too much to take from recent efforts; cheekpieces now added.

RaceName: Money Back Daily Specials With Tote.ie Handicap
Spotlight: Off the mark over C&D last month on good ground, soft ground probably against him at Galway (beaten when hampered); cheekpieces retained and could bounce back.

RaceName: Money Back Daily Specials With Tote.ie Handicap
Spotlight: Hurdle winner has won twice on the Flat, the latest over 2m1f at Limerick in 2025; hasn't been too far away of late and has been dropped a few lbs, now 3lb below that winning mark.

RaceName: Money Back Daily Specials With Tote.ie Handicap
Spotlight: Quite lightly-raced 3yo has a bit to find with Darius Dark on Curragh run, plenty keen and not clear run at Limerick on latest; may yet do better if settling.

RaceName: Money Back Daily Specials With Tote.ie Handicap
Spotlight: Good opening efforts in handicaps, staying on late over 1m2f at Cork and raced handier over slightly shorter at Gowran, weakening late on when only beaten 1l into fourth; upped in trip now and contender if he stays.

RaceName: QuinnBet Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Won his first three races over fences (2m4f to an extended 2m5f) and, in first-time cheekpieces, ran well enough at Cartmel (2m1f; Krak 15l behind) to believe he's still on a workable mark; hard to knock.

RaceName: QuinnBet Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Five wins over hurdles and opened chasing account over 2m7f at Worcester in June off 5lb lower (under Beau Morgan claiming his 5lb); respectable since on two visits to Uttoxeter, in a Class 2 and last time behind a Skelton improver; good chance.

RaceName: QuinnBet Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Winning hurdler in Ireland and runner-up over hurdles on final run for the Twiston-Davies yard; back over fences (0-4) in two runs for Dan Skelton and didn't see either race out with much purpose (2m/2m1f), and those were after a wind operation; reservations for now and returning to further isn't an obvious positive.

RaceName: Brehon Hotel & Spa Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Consistency over hurdles this season was rewarded here last time when gaining a first win (2m5f, good) off 7lb lower; must carry joint top weight on chasing debut but he's in good form.

RaceName: Brehon Hotel & Spa Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Best of three chase runs was the first at Kilbeggan last year, when sixth of 13; beaten 24l at Clonmel in October off 1lb higher on handicap chase debut; two starts over hurdles since not too encouraging.

RaceName: Brehon Hotel & Spa Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Hasn't run badly at times in six runs over fences, including when fourth of nine in a Tramore beginners' chase last time (2m6f, good); won here over hurdles on seasonal return/stable debut in May (2m4f, good to yielding) off 104; could go well.

RaceName: Brehon Hotel & Spa Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Back-to-back handicap chase winner last summer, the second of those over 2m7f here (yielding to soft) off 92; sent off favourite for the same race last month but weakened quickly and was pulled up; cheekpieces worn that day are now left off, but questions linger.

RaceName: Brehon Hotel & Spa Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Won a Wexford handicap hurdle for Brendan Walsh in 2024 off 87, and first success since came in a 2m4f Limerick handicap chase in May (good to yielding) off 6lb lower; disappointed as favourite when attempting to take advantage of his lower hurdles mark at Cork last time (2m1f, good); not ruled out now back chasing.

RaceName: Brehon Hotel & Spa Handicap Chase
OwnerName: Miss Rachel O'Neill & John C Hurley
Spotlight: Safely held at Uttoxeter in a 2m4f handicap chase and a 3m handicap hurdle last month; now 0-10 under rules; others preferred.

RaceName: Brehon Hotel & Spa Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Bagged a first hurdles win at Listowel in June on her second run for the yard (2m, yielding); hasn't looked as good over fences in two tries to date.

RaceName: Brehon Hotel & Spa Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Won a maiden hurdle here in 2024; went close to adding to his tally in a Tipperary handicap chase in July last year off 3lb lower (2m1f, yielding); well beaten over hurdles at Cork on return, but has tended to improve with runs in the past.

RaceName: Brehon Hotel & Spa Handicap Chase
Spotlight: On a long losing run and needs to improve markedly on recent efforts over fences; hard to fancy.

RaceName: Compare Betting Sites At gambling.com Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

RaceName: Compare Betting Sites At gambling.com Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Beaten in the region of 12l in a 6f novice and 5f maiden; one for handicaps.

RaceName: Compare Betting Sites At gambling.com Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

RaceName: Compare Betting Sites At gambling.com Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Third foal; half-sister to winners Royal Favour (UAE 9.5f dirt; RPR 96) and Nochebuena (1m4f; 93); dam Peruvian 1m/1m2f Group 1 winner, half-sister to Peruvian champion grass horse More Than Words; the sire instils some speed into the pedigree; the market should be enlightening.

RaceName: Compare Betting Sites At gambling.com Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 140,000gns yearling; fourth foal; sister to 5f 2yo winner Supreme Diamond (RPR 66) and half-sister to 6f winner Sayidah Dariyan (Group 3; 115); dam French 7f winner; could be interesting, all the more so if strong in the betting.

RaceName: Compare Betting Sites At gambling.com Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Finished midfield at Ripon (6f), beaten just over 7l at odds of 66-1; should win races in time but this is highly unlikely to be one of those.

RaceName: Leopardstown Golf, Padel & Range Maiden
Spotlight: Towards the rear throughout on debut in a Roscommon bumper earlier this month and 8 days later didn't count in midfield in Gowran flat maiden (9.5f); hard to see him making the required improvement to feature here.

RaceName: Leopardstown Golf, Padel & Range Maiden
Spotlight: Too Darn Hot gelding was a 450,000gns yearling; brother to 7f/7.4f 2yo winner Zenjabeela (inc AW; RPR 91), half-brother to three winners inc Cell Sa Beela (7f/7.4f inc 2yo/Listed; 102); dam unraced half-sister to 1m Group 1 winners Alpha Centauri and Alpine Star; well-bred 4yo making a belated debut, has to be respected.

RaceName: Leopardstown Golf, Padel & Range Maiden
Spotlight: Both recent runs suggest he'll be of more interest when going handicapping.

RaceName: Leopardstown Golf, Padel & Range Maiden
Spotlight: Well-bred Wootton Bassett gelding had run in a barrier trial before two ordinary recent runs in maidens, latest when never landing a blow over 1m4f at Tramore five days ago; best watched for now.

RaceName: Leopardstown Golf, Padel & Range Maiden
Spotlight: Cotai Glory half-brother to 1m5f turf/2m AW winner Elle Dorado Rock (RPR 69); dam 1m 2yo winner (71), half-sister to Group-placed 9.4f-11.4f winner Majeed; never better than midfield on AW debut five days ago, seems best watched.

RaceName: Leopardstown Golf, Padel & Range Maiden
Spotlight: Hint of promise on debut at Killarney last month and nice bit of improvement 9 days later when staying on late to chase home a long odds-on shot at Cork (clear of remainder); over 1m; more possibly needed but definite contender.

RaceName: Leopardstown Golf, Padel & Range Maiden
Spotlight: Boiled over, bolted to post and unseated rider before Curragh debut, where he ran keen and dropped out to finish in rear; hood didn't appear have a major impact at Dundalk last month, can only be watched for now.

RaceName: Leopardstown Golf, Padel & Range Maiden
Spotlight: Midfield finish here a fortnight ago was a bit more encouraging but likely more one for handicaps in due course.

RaceName: Leopardstown Golf, Padel & Range Maiden
OwnerName: Joseph E Keeling & Aidan Gleeson & M C Grassick
Spotlight: All three runs have been over 6f, showing definite promise last autumn at Naas and the Curragh, reappearing early this month at former venue when never dangerous staying-on third of 5 (couple of 80+ rated rivals behind) in conditions event; half-brother Texas Rock won over 1m so good chance he'll stay, big player if he does.

RaceName: Leopardstown Golf, Padel & Range Maiden
Spotlight: Late gains into midfield on debut at Gowran (1m) in May, catching the attention of the stewards (rider reported he ran green before staying on); improvement likely although lacks a recent run.

RaceName: Leopardstown Golf, Padel & Range Maiden
Spotlight: Respectable debut run at Gowran in May over this trip, returning from a couple of months' break with decent third at Galway over 7f; more possible back at 1m.

RaceName: Leopardstown Golf, Padel & Range Maiden
Spotlight: South African-bred filly was set a stiff task on debut in Gowran winners' contest last month, showing promise when a staying-on fourth over 9.5f; technically not yet a 3yo (born in October 2023) so can be expected to improve with time; not sure this drop in trip will suit.

RaceName: Leopardstown Golf, Padel & Range Maiden
Spotlight: Phoenix Of Spain filly cost E13,000 as a yearling, related to three prolific and useful winners, two of them on AW; tongue-tied, never competitive but not discredited on Dundalk debut last month; may need more experience

RaceName: Happy Birthday Sue Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Ex-Irish pointer; won comfortably on stable debut at Bangor (3m) and the 18l defeat here was only four days later under a penalty and back over 2m3f; 1lb higher now but good reason to expect much better from her.

RaceName: Happy Birthday Sue Handicap Chase
Spotlight: 3m2f winner at Newton Abbot in June and his next run was over hurdles; latest defeat, back at Newton Abbot over his winning trip, is harder to forgive.

RaceName: Happy Birthday Sue Handicap Chase
OwnerName: David W Jagger & Mrs Belinda Clarke

RaceName: Happy Birthday Sue Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Last season ended on a low note, as he wasn't in much form before pulling up here in April behind Yes And Yes; the cheekpieces returned for his June run and he perhaps went off too hard having been clear at one stage (often front runs); has wellbeing issues to address, but he's on a handy mark and Jack Tudor is back aboard replacing a 7lb claimer (up top last three races).

RaceName: Happy Birthday Sue Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Limited hurdler; unconvincing point form before finishing tailed off on second run over fences at Newton Abbot (2m5f); he was only 7-2 that day so better was perhaps expected, but he's risky.

RaceName: Happy Birthday Sue Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Nine-race maiden under rules; his third on chase debut two runs back was quite remote and then tailed off on his return to hurdles; 3lb out of the weights.

RaceName: Gallivan Financial Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Five-time chase winner is now off a career-high mark following his win at Wexford in May; was poor over hurdles recently at Cork, but can be expected to do better now back over fences; a player.

RaceName: Gallivan Financial Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Has hit form back on good ground since switched to this yard, winning chases at Tramore and a career-best when winning over C&D last time; got a 9lb hike for that, but has to be on the short-list.

RaceName: Gallivan Financial Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Flat, hurdle and chase winner but his win record in only 3-49 under rules; below form over fences at Galway last time, but would have a chance on his earlier fourth to Crowsatedappletart at Wexford in May.

RaceName: Gallivan Financial Handicap Chase
Spotlight: A wide-margin 2m4f Kilbeggan maiden hurdle winner last year but didn't really go on from that over hurdles; similar efforts in defeat in three chase starts, but has to find more dropping down in trip.

RaceName: Gallivan Financial Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Bumper and hurdle winner has run well enough in defeat over fences including a fourth at Wexford last time; should be competitive on handicap debut.

RaceName: Gallivan Financial Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Dual hurdle winner lost his form over fences (unlucky twice too) earlier this year but posted a solid hurdle effort at Bellewstown last time behind the Galway Hurdle winner; the blinkers worn then are retained and should go well for his in-form yard.

RaceName: Gallivan Financial Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Dual chase winner won at Tramore in April and was second to Crowsatedappletart at Wexford in May; got badly hampered so ran respectably at Galway last time; capable of being involved.

RaceName: Gallivan Financial Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Got off the mark over fences at Wexford last month and a solid effort there since off this mark; needs to find a bit more but shouldn't be far away.

RaceName: Gallivan Financial Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Hurdle winner has been soundly beaten in three chases but put up respectable runs in beginners' events the last twice behind smart sorts, including over C&D; might not be too far away.

RaceName: Harry Potter Droneart Show Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: He's improved with each of his three starts and justified favouritism on his nursery debut at Carlisle (5f, good) last Tuesday; the clear runner-up has since gone one better in good style and a 6lb penalty may not stop this gelding on his first AW start, for which cheekpieces go on.

RaceName: Harry Potter Droneart Show Nursery Handicap
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid
Spotlight: Went close in two of his three novice races (6f, good) and not beaten far in fourth of five on recent nursery debut at Windsor (6f, good to firm), where shaping as though 5f would be worth exploring; might be in the mix.

RaceName: Harry Potter Droneart Show Nursery Handicap

RaceName: Harry Potter Droneart Show Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Improving profile in the spring, winning a novice at Carlisle (5f, good) in May on her fourth start; tailed off at 33-1 on nursery debut at Glorious Goodwood (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago following a two-month break but she's back in calmer waters today and is not written off.

RaceName: Harry Potter Droneart Show Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Promising third on debut at Doncaster in May and he's back at 5f for the first time since; however, his form has gone the wrong way and he's been soundly beaten over 6f in his two nurseries; others have less to prove.

RaceName: Harry Potter Droneart Show Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Neck second in a match at Ayr (6f, good to firm) last month on first run since being gelded and close third of seven on subsequent nursery debut at Nottingham (6f, good to firm) where he showed bright pace; this first attempt at 5f might be a good move; could be a contender in first-time blinkers.

RaceName: Dublin To Bahrain Fillies Handicap

RaceName: Dublin To Bahrain Fillies Handicap
Spotlight: C&D winner last summer is without a win this year but two good runs in Curragh contests on quick ground; not at same level at Gowran on latest, having raced prominently; cheekpieces now added.

RaceName: Dublin To Bahrain Fillies Handicap

RaceName: Dublin To Bahrain Fillies Handicap

RaceName: Dublin To Bahrain Fillies Handicap
Spotlight: Front-runner's five wins include back-to-back successes earlier in the summer at Roscommon and Gowran; good run at former venue back at 7f on latest off this mark; should make a bold bid again.

RaceName: Dublin To Bahrain Fillies Handicap

RaceName: Dublin To Bahrain Fillies Handicap
Spotlight: Improving mare seeking to complete a hat-trick, following a Killarney success when overcoming 7lb rise in 1m1f contest here a fortnight ago, having to wait for an opening and getting first run on runner-up when holding on by a head (pair clear); another 8lb rise to overcome but thriving.

RaceName: Dublin To Bahrain Fillies Handicap
Spotlight: Last of two wins came here over 1m1f last summer off 74; seasonal-best came over same C&D a fortnight ago when strong-finishing third (from a wide draw) of 22 to Bella Colombia (fourth has won since); nice turn around in weights with that rival here and cheekpieces added; should go well.

RaceName: Sun Racing Summer Jumps Championship Handicap Hurdle

RaceName: Sun Racing Summer Jumps Championship Handicap Hurdle

RaceName: Sun Racing Summer Jumps Championship Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: 1-25 on the Flat; kept on for third on handicap hurdle debut at Southwell (2m, good) in June but two lesser efforts have followed and it's questionable whether the refitted cheekpieces will make the necessary difference.

RaceName: Sun Racing Summer Jumps Championship Handicap Hurdle

RaceName: Sun Racing Summer Jumps Championship Handicap Hurdle

RaceName: Sun Racing Summer Jumps Championship Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Opened account over C&D (good) on stable debut in June, readily drawing 7l clear; might still have more to offer for his new trainer but was safely held when favourite at Uttoxeter last month; needs to bounce back.

RaceName: Sun Racing Summer Jumps Championship Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Unplaced all five hurdling starts but wasn't beaten far in his two handicaps in the spring (2m/2m1f, good) and now returns to this track for first time since comfortably winning a bumper last spring; interesting

RaceName: Sun Racing Summer Jumps Championship Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: No match for comfortable winner when second of five on stable/handicap debut at Uttoxeter (2m, good; reportedly made respiratory noise) in June but that was his first run for 462 days and he now has a tongue-tie fitted; improvement possible.

RaceName: Sun Racing Summer Jumps Championship Handicap Hurdle

RaceName: Sun Racing Summer Jumps Championship Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Posted several good efforts in defeat over C&D before finally making her breakthrough at Uttoxeter (2m, good) last month, her 27th start over hurdles; might be a shade vulnerable after recent 4lb rise but ought to give another good account.

RaceName: Sun Racing Summer Jumps Championship Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Showed no significant promise in three novice/maiden hurdles here (2m-2m2f) in June/July and is 8lb out of the weights for this handicap debut; significant improvement required.

RaceName: Peadar's Pub Glenbeigh INH Flat Race

RaceName: Peadar's Pub Glenbeigh INH Flat Race

RaceName: Peadar's Pub Glenbeigh INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Some fair efforts in bumpers and over hurdles, but has to find significant improvement to score.

RaceName: Peadar's Pub Glenbeigh INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Was just denied by a smart rival in a Cork bumper on debut in 2024 over this trip; has a long absence to overcome, but if he can run even close to that form, then would have a big shout; the market can guide with an inexperienced rider aboard.

RaceName: Peadar's Pub Glenbeigh INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Posted similar efforts in defeat in bumpers at Punchestown and Roscommon in varying ground conditions; was just in front of Rocky Alfonso on latter occasion but might struggle to uphold that form today.

RaceName: Peadar's Pub Glenbeigh INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Flat-bred gelding ran creditably on bumper debut at Roscommon on ground that would have been soft enough; should have improved since and this livelier ground can suit better, so looks a big player with improvement to come.

RaceName: Peadar's Pub Glenbeigh INH Flat Race
OwnerName: Exors of the Late Michael Moloney
Spotlight: Posted a promising debut over C&D before being tailed-off in a Galway bumper; has to resume progress in a major way.

RaceName: Peadar's Pub Glenbeigh INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Was weak in the market and ran green on debut over C&D last month but still showed potential; the form of that race has taken some knocks, but this mare should be sharper today and still be a big player; tongue-tie added.

RaceName: Peadar's Pub Glenbeigh INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Some decent efforts in defeat in four bumper starts for this yard and Terence O'Brien; has to build on that to win.

RaceName: Knox Hydrate Handicap
Spotlight: Better on AW than turf so two defeats on the grass aren't especially damaging to his claims here; won easily at Wolverhampton (5f) on his most recent start and he is respected back on Tapeta.

RaceName: Knox Hydrate Handicap
Spotlight: Often slowly away but his refusal to race at Redcar last month was a new low; blinkers tried there are quickly dispensed with; hard to recommend after latest display.

RaceName: Knox Hydrate Handicap
Spotlight: Ended a losing run at Pontefract (5f, good to soft) in May; not so good since and others are more persuasive ahead of his AW debut.

RaceName: Knox Hydrate Handicap
Spotlight: C&D win off 1lb higher last November; retains all his ability as a 7yo and he is a major player back on Tapeta.

RaceName: Knox Hydrate Handicap
OwnerName: D Caslin, P Wilcock & M Cantillon
Spotlight: Made a promising return to action at Beverley (5f, good to soft) in April but two runs since have been underwhelming; on a dangerous mark and there is encouragement for AW on pedigree.

RaceName: Knox Hydrate Handicap

RaceName: Knox Hydrate Handicap
Spotlight: Grand servant to connections and he was recording the 19th win of his long career when successful at Beverley (5f, good to soft) in May; four subsequent defeats have seen him slip to a mark 2lb lower than for that win; has won over C&D but likely vulnerable to younger rivals.

RaceName: Knox Hydrate Handicap
OwnerName: D P Van Der Hoeven & D G Pryde
Spotlight: Completed a sprint hat-trick last summer and he has repeated the feat this time around, coming here on the back of wins at Ayr, Beverley and Thirsk; up 4lb as he bids for the four-timer; should be in the thick of it again.

RaceName: Knox Hydrate Handicap
OwnerName: N Irving, F Steele & I Jardine
Spotlight: Five wins this year, three of them over C&D; took her form to a new level when winning at Hamilton 19 days ago but a 6lb rise and stronger opposition could find her out today.

RaceName: Knox Hydrate Handicap
Spotlight: Three course wins for Bryan Smart; yet to shine for his current trainer but he is edging down the weights and he shouldn't be underestimated.

RaceName: Knox Hydrate Handicap
Spotlight: Multiple C&D winner; ran his best race for some time when third of ten at Beverley last week; major player back on AW.

RaceName: Knox Hydrate Handicap
Spotlight: A fair 5f juvenile winner; back to form with fourth in 5f Beverley handicap in May and didn't enjoy a smooth run (also stumbled 1f out) when sixth of seven at Pontefract (5f) last time; returns from a break in a competitive race and others may have his measure.

RaceName: Knox Hydrate Handicap
Spotlight: Back to form with a bang when winning a C&D handicap 26 days ago; that was a lowly Class 6 event though and a 7lb rise against deeper opposition looks beyond her.

RaceName: Mini Golf At High Gosforth Park Handicap
Spotlight: Consistency wasn't his strong suit for his former yard and his recent stable debut was hardly chock full of promise; drops in grade but comes with risks attached.

RaceName: Mini Golf At High Gosforth Park Handicap
Spotlight: Two AW wins earlier in the year and he was back at his best when second at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) 19 days ago; has his first 6f run since his racecourse debut today but it shouldn't be a problem; high on the list.

RaceName: Mini Golf At High Gosforth Park Handicap
Spotlight: Eight-time winner; made a winning stable debut for Laura Mongan (1m, AW) in March but that wasn't a springboard to better things; sold for 2,000gns in July; return to 6f should suit on stable debut.

RaceName: Mini Golf At High Gosforth Park Handicap
Spotlight: Modest strike-rate but she ran well on her seasonal and stable debut at Thirsk (6f, good), finishing second of 17; 2lb rise fair enough and she needs serious consideration.

RaceName: Mini Golf At High Gosforth Park Handicap
Spotlight: The handicapper has been in command this summer and although he didn't run badly at Doncaster 19 days ago, he will need more for the switch to AW.

RaceName: Mini Golf At High Gosforth Park Handicap
Spotlight: Exposed maiden who is proving expensive to follow, beaten favourite on his last four starts; running well enough to be right in the picture here though.

RaceName: Mini Golf At High Gosforth Park Handicap
Spotlight: Won three sprint handicaps at Southwell in the spring; form has dipped more recently but he has slipped in the weights and Jack Nicholls takes off a handy 5lb; market instructive.

RaceName: Mini Golf At High Gosforth Park Handicap
Spotlight: Four AW wins (all at Wolverhampton) to her name; arrives on the back of a good win at Ayr (6f, good to soft) ten days ago and should be fine at this track; one to consider under her penalty.

RaceName: Mini Golf At High Gosforth Park Handicap
Spotlight: Just modest form in three 1m runs here early in the year (flattered by peak RPR in a slowly run race); goes handicapping at a modest level but the drop in trip needs to have a positive effect.

RaceName: Mini Golf At High Gosforth Park Handicap
Spotlight: Has a course win (5f) amongst his seven wins but the latest was back in May 2025; two respectable turf runs for Des Donovan and he's one to consider.

RaceName: Mini Golf At High Gosforth Park Handicap
Spotlight: Hardly prolific but he has six C&D wins on his record, the latest three weeks ago when coming from off the pace to win decisively in 0-50 classified company; this is tougher but we know he's capable when in top form.

RaceName: Mini Golf At High Gosforth Park Handicap
Spotlight: 15-race maiden; in fair form on turf this summer, placed over 6f twice before fair 7f efforts on her last starts; the return to 6f won't hurt and she did run well on AW once when trained in Ireland.

RaceName: Mini Golf At High Gosforth Park Handicap
OwnerName: John And Tony Jarvis And Partner
Spotlight: C&D winner; on a long losing run but there have been enough good runs this year to give him an each-way squeak.

RaceName: Mini Golf At High Gosforth Park Handicap
Spotlight: Regressive veteran; finished second at Catterick (5f, good) in May but little to celebrate since; vulnerable once more.
